articleTitle: People Counting in Public Spaces using Deep Learning-based Object Detection and Tracking Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Recent advancements in deep learning and machine learning have enabled exact people counting in various applications including crowd management, security, and retail analytics. Deep learning algorithms have proven tremendous promise for accurate and efficient people counting in difficult contexts. This paper offers a technique for counting people that utilises deep learning with MobileNet SSD, centroid tracking, and trackable object script. Gathering and preparing a labelled dataset, training a MobileNet SSD model, implementing centroid tracking and the trackable object script, increasing system performance, testing it on real-world scenarios, and deploying it in a production environment are all part of the approach. The recommended approach provides a wide framework for creating and deploying a deep learning-based people-counting system that can be customized and tuned to match a number of applications and purposes. Additionally, we have added alerts on maximum capacity, timely scheduling and input feed from the internet.

articleTitle: A Logistic Regression and Decision Tree Based Hybrid Approach to Predict Alzheimer's Disease
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Alzheimer's disease is a degenerative neurological disorder that typically impacts individuals over the age of 65, causing damage to the brain and resulting in challenges with memory, cognition, and behavior. Although there is currently no cure for this condition, various therapies and medications exist to manage symptoms and slow the progression of the disease. Individuals with Alzheimer's disease experience cognitive impairment, changes in behavior, and communication difficulties, often leading to psychological and behavioral issues like anxiety, aggression, and depression. In this research paper, a novel approach to predicting outcomes using MRI data sets from the Open Access Series of Imaging Studies (OASIS) is proposed. The method involves data exploration, data preprocessing, and the development of a hybrid model that utilizes both Logistic Regression and Decision Tree algorithms. Through rigorous testing, the proposed hybrid model demonstrated superior accuracy compared to existing models, achieving an overall accuracy rate of 96%.

articleTitle: Soft Computing Techniques Implication for the Exhaustive Intelligent Review Analysis for Electric Vehicle Charging System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: This paper shows the detailed intelligent monitoring survey analysis of an electric vehicle's charging system from various generating sources by using soft computing techniques. The different modes of charging, such as the conductive and inductive charging methods, along with their efficiency, power output, and cost, have been discussed. The performance parameters like state of charge (SOC) and THD (%) of various existing literature have been analyzed. The purpose of this study is to compare the available Electric Vehicle Charging Technologies and figure out the best possible alternative for present-day traction scenarios, as well as use the results to identify the shortcomings of the present technologies. The results of this study can be further utilized in the fabrication of new and flawless EV charging technologies that are both cost-and power-efficient, offer hassle-free traction, and make the transition from ICE to EV a viable alternative for customers. At the end of this study, it is observed that performance parameters have been greatly improved with battery swap technology in comparison to other methodologies, which mainly comprise Fuzzy Logic Control (FLC) and Artificial Neural Networks (ANN).

articleTitle: An Exhaustive Analysis of Waste Segregation and Hand Sanitization in Post-Covid Era
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Waste segregation has become significant in today's time and this awareness is increasing day by day. Countries all around the world are becoming conscious about the acing health-related problems due to myriads of infectious diseases spreading with each passing day. The waste from such an infected person needs to be discarded of carefully since these viral infections can propagate not only from each person to another but also through using it or handling that waste. This article focuses on the categorization of waste and the methodology to do so. The emphasis is laid on the healthcare sector and reducing manual scavenging. It includes the various implementation strategies for waste segregation and throws light on the significance of the hand sanitization mechanism.

articleTitle: A Review of Machine Learning Frameworks for Predicting Adverse Events in Cloud-based Healthcare Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: The concept of “Smart Healthcare” has surfaced recently, owing to the progressions made in information technology. Implementing advanced information technologies, such as Cloud-Computing(CC), Artificial Intelligence(AI), Machine Learning(ML), and the Internet of Things (IoT), within the Healthcare sector has led to “Smart Healthcare.” The primary objective of this approach is to enhance traditional medical practices across all domains. This study aims to comprehensively examine and evaluate the current models and frameworks centered on ML and CC in the context of Smart Healthcare, as put forth by multiple scholars. This study presents an algorithm for integrating Machine Learning with Cloud Computing.

articleTitle: A review on WSN clustering algorithms in loT based applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: With the goal of connecting almost all smart devices on the planet, the Internet of Things (IoT) represents a singular shift in the networking paradigm. Due to the numerous limitations of these smart devices, their deployment will only be successful with an energy-efficient routing. The sensor nodes (SNs) are grouped into the clusters by clustering algorithms, and a cluster head (CH) is selected for each group which leads each cluster. The algorithms for clustering normally discussed for Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) based applications, but their applications in the IoT might also addresses the same comparable difficulties. By transferring a major portion of the communication overhead to the CH, clustering would promote energy efficient routing and topology maintenance. This paper provides an overview of various clustering algorithms, as well as an analysis of the routing features of several IoT fields and recommendations for acceptable clustering algorithm for each field.

articleTitle: Odd Counter: New Design and Performance Analysis using Carbon Nano Tube Transistors for High Performance Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Recent advances in CMOS technologies and beyond CMOS technologies have enabled the researchers to design the circuits for High Performance Applications. This research paper is focused on the new design of Odd Counter for High Performance Applications using CNTFET and the comparison of their performance with similar CMOS counterpart. In this paper, counters have been analyzed with the variation of temperature from 25°C to 100°C while the variation of supply voltages is from 0.7V to 1.3V. For all temperatures, proposed CNTFET Counter has the least power consumption, shortest delay, and lowest PDP. For all supply voltages, the proposed CNTFET Counter also has the least power consumption, shortest delay, and lowest PDP. SPICE has been utilized for simulating the Counters. Even though the fabrication is more complicated than CMOS counterparts, simulation results confirm usefulness of CNTFET Odd Counter for high speed and power efficient systems. This circuit is especially applicable where specified number of odd objects like vehicles having odd numbers is to be allowed.

articleTitle: Face Mask Recognition Using OpenCV
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: The world is experiencing several issues because of the spread of coronavirus (COVID-19). Wearing a facemask is an effective approach for protection against coronavirus, according to WHO standards. Though it is impossible to keep track of whether or not everyone is wearing a mask, it is possible to keep an eye on them. Face mask detection will be achieved using a CNN (convolutional neural network) model employing Tensor flow, Kera's library, and OpenCV (to do real-time face detection) in this. The goal of this paper is to determine that the person in a picture or video stream wearing a mask or not. 97% approval precision was accomplished amid the training of the CNN demonstrate, when an individual is wearing a facemask at that point an exactness rate of 98% was achieved. The experimental outcomes indicate that the approach proposed in this research can identify face masks and enable efficient personnel surveillance.

articleTitle: Normal and Abnormal ECG Signal Classification using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: A technique for tracking heart rate using electrodes and spotting minute electrical changes in individual heart rates is called an electrocardiogram (ECG). This looks at a variety of aberrant cardiac processes, including arrhythmias and conduction issues. In this study, deep learning, a classification approach, is used to classify normal and abnormal ECG data using the suggested method. To demonstrate the effectiveness of the suggested method, images of the ECG signals' scalograms are compared with those of the traditional SVM and ANN classifiers.

articleTitle: Accuracy Prediction using Machine Learning Techniques for Indian Patient Liver Disease
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: One of the principal cause of mortality in the countryis liver disease. Each year, liver disease kills more than 2.4 percent of all Indians. As a result,for the early intervention of liver disease, anautomated programme with higher accuracy and reliability is necessary. Specific machine learning models such as SVM, Logistic Regression, KNN, and ANN are being created for this purpose in order to foretell liver disease with more precision, accuracy, and reliability.

articleTitle: A Role of Hierarchical Clustering Algorithms in Wireless Sensor Networks -A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Aggregation and fusion of data within the cluster make the hierarchical clustering a cost-effective approach for lowering the total energy usage within the Wireless Sensor networks (WSNs). As a result, the quantity of data sent to the Base station (BS) gets reduced. Clusters form hierarchical WSNs which make the more effective use of Sensor nodes (SNs) resources and extend the lifetime of the network. The consumption of energy of the overall network gets reduced, and it also increases the total system scalability. The goal of this research is to give a review on hierarchical clustering in WSNs. A comparison of alternative hierarchical clustering techniques based on cluster features, Selection of cluster head (CH), heterogeneity, and clustering processes is also included in this paper.

articleTitle: Diabetic Retinopathy Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: According to a recent survey by WHO, every fourth person is diabetic. It can be due to lifestyle, pollution, heredity or many other reasons. A diabetic person with the time has some threats in life. One of these threats is Retinopathy which is a well-known microvascular consequence of diabetes mellitus that poses a risk to vision is diabetic retinopathy. Worldwide, 93 million people have diabetic retinopathy at this time. Studies on the prevalence of diabetic retinopathy and risk factors are lacking. People who have diabetes may have more chances to develop diabetic retinopathy, an eye disorder that can lead to blindness. The retina's blood vessels are impacted (the light-sensitive layer of tissue in the back of your eye). It's crucial to undergo a thorough dilated eye exam at least once a year if you have diabetes. In this paper, we have used the deep learning method by taking a single snapshot of the human fundus for detecting the stage of diabetic retinopathy. We have also suggested the multistage transfer learning method, which uses comparable datasets with various labelling. With a sensitivity and specificity of 0.99, the proposed method can be used as early diagnosis of diabetic retinopathy on APTOS 2019 dataset for Detecting Blindness (13000 images). We employed a deep learning model Shapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) for game theoretic strategies to research the diagnosis of diabetic retinopathy. In order to associate optimal credit allocation with local explanations, it makes use of the conventional Shapley values from game theory and their related extensions. To understand the predictions of our model and how to further improve its performance, in this study we will train a base ResNet50 model, evaluate it, and use the SHAP model's explain ability technique.

articleTitle: A Review on Optimality Investigation Strategies for the Balanced Assignment Problem
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Mathematical Selection is a method in which we select a particular choice from a set of such. It have always been an interesting field of study for mathematicians. Accordingly, Combinatorial Optimization is a sub field of this domain of Mathematical Selection, where we generally, deal with prob-lems subjecting to Operation Research, Artificial Intelligence and many more promising domains. In a broader sense, an optimization problem entails maximising or minimising a real function by systematically selecting input values from within an allowed set and computing the function's value. A broad region of applied mathematics is the generalisation of metaheuristic theory and methods to other formulations. More broadly, optimization entails determining the finest virtues of some fitness function, offered a fixed space, which may include a variety of distinct types of decision variables and contexts. In this work, we will be working on the famous Balanced Assignment Problem, and will propose a comparative analysis on the Complexity Metrics of Computational Time for different Notions of solving the Balanced Assignment Problem.

articleTitle: Boosting Solar Energy Production of a Building using New Architectural Design
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Fossil fuels and air pollution are significant problems nowadays, causing many countries to increase their investments in renewable energy development. As the world's energy demand grows, governments are looking into and developing alternative energy sources like solar energy. Solar energy is one of the most promising solutions to address the above problem. In addition, the development of sustainable design in architecture has become a crucial factor in the construction industry as the world faces the challenges of climate change and diminishing fossil fuel reserves. Architects are now seeking innovative ways to incorporate sustainable and renewable energy sources into their designs. Solar energy, as a sustainable and clean energy source, has gained significant attention in recent years. It offers an opportunity to reduce the dependence on non-renewable energy sources and lower carbon emissions. Additionally, the use of solar technology in architectural designs can enhance the aesthetic appeal of buildings while providing energy efficiency. Building-integrated photovoltaic systems have emerged as a popular solution that allows for the integration of photovoltaic cells into the structure of buildings. In this paper, a new architectural design for a building in Tehran is proposed, which leads to the increase of generated solar energy. Needless to say, the designs must be beautiful to look at, functional, and good for the environment. Grasshopper and rhino are utilized to demonstrate the design. In addition, System Advisor Model (SAM) is implemented to study the economic analysis of the solar photovoltaic system planted on the building. The simulation result indicates that with the new design, the power production is increased from 21437 kWh to 69484 kWh. In addition, by using the proposed system in comparison with fossil fuel power plants, a huge amount of air pollution is will be removed from the air.

articleTitle: Diagnosing Phytophthora infestans infestations on Solanum tuberosum leaves using Machine Learning Classifiers
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: In reaction to recent technology breakthroughs, modern computational fields such as the IoT, Data Science, Machine Learning, AI, and several more have arisen. Humans benefit greatly from these fields. In this study, we would employ parts of machine learning to forecast plant illnesses. Particularly amongst the potato leaves, severe Late Blight Disease was discovered. The potato plant, also known as Solanum tuberosum, is a significant crop that is planted all over the world and yields copious amounts of nutritious tubers. The potato is a frequent staple food and has several health benefits. When ingested in moderation, the fluid extracted from tubers can cure stomach ulcers and reduce inflammation and acidity. Both Early and Late Blight are dangerous and widespread potato diseases. We would concentrate on Late Blight in this effort. A fatal fungus that harms potatoes is called Late Blight. It is accessible everywhere in the world. It can be found in areas of the world where potatoes are grown. Winter is the primary growing season for potatoes in India. It is followed by sweltering summer months in the lowlands. Heat and dryness kill the fungus that lives in the soil. The fungus Phytophthora Infestans, the most prevalent agricultural disease that causes the Late blight of potatoes, can quickly result in crop failure if appropriate control measures are not adopted. Potato crop declines in epidemic years might be as high as 80%. We acquired a collection of roughly one thousand samples of Late Blight-affected leaves of potatoes for this investigation. With the help of conventional classifier algorithms, we have developed a machine-learning classification paradigm that may be able to forecast the onset of Late Blight disease. Medical science has developed significantly. Plant pathology could be able to prevent the threat from happening if we could perhaps predict the illness in its early stages.

articleTitle: Improved Facial Biometric Authentication Using MobileNetV2
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: One of the successful biometric technologies has been face recognition. Despite its enormous success, face recognition has drawbacks, much like any biometric technology. Face spoofing attacks, which are still possible with facial recognition technologies, have become a common threat to biometric applications. Many algorithms have recently been applied to publicly available datasets. However, efficiency has been a concern. One model cannot be a generalized solution for all attacks, so testing datasets over different models is needed to know all the possibilities. In this paper, a deep-learning method MobileNetV2 is proposed, which uses transfer learning and is a lighter convolutional network that is tested over the NUAA Dataset, which is publicly available. The proposed method shows better results than state-of-the-art methods over the same dataset.

articleTitle: Plant Infirmity Detection Using Vgg -16 Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: This research paper aims to leverage state-of-the-art deep learning techniques to detect plant diseases in agriculture with greater accuracy and timeliness, with a particular emphasis on the Indian economy. Agriculture is a critical aspect of the Indian economy, and plant diseases caused by climatic factors, pests, and weather conditions can significantly affect the economy. CNNs mimic the structure and function of the visual cortex in the brain and learn spatial hierarchies of features automatically and adaptively impact productivity and yield. Early and precise identification of plant diseases is crucial to estimating agricultural production and maximizing resources while minimizing the use of pesticides. The VGG-16 convolutional neural network architecture which uses Rectified Linear Units (ReLU) activation function is used and it has been shown to be highly effective and accurate in detecting and diagnosing plant diseases. Additionally, we have integrated a Graphical User Interface (GUI) that can provide an intuitive platform for users to input plant images and obtain detailed diagnostic information along with an efficient solution to the plant disease. Using these techniques, the research aims to increase productivity and yield by detecting plant diseases early and accurately. The paper also discusses potential avenues for further research and the challenges that still exist in identifying plant diseases using available technology.

articleTitle: Unified View of Damage leaves Planimetry & Analysis Using Digital Images Processing Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: The detection of leaf diseases in plants generally involves visual observation of patterns appearing on the leaf surface. However, there are many diseases that are distinguished based on very subtle changes in these visually observable patterns. This paper attempts to identify plant leaf diseases using image processing techniques. The focus of this study is on the detection of citrus leaf canker disease. Canker is a bacterial infection of leaves. Symptoms of citrus cankers include brown spots on the leaves, often with a watery or oily appearance. The spots (called lesions in botany) are usually yellow. It is surrounded by a halo of the leaves and is found on both the top and bottom of the leaf. This paper describes various methods that have been used to detect citrus leaf canker disease. The methods used are histogram comparison and k-means clustering. Using these methods, citrus canker development was detected based on histograms generated based on leaf patterns. The results thus obtained can be used, after consultation with experts in the field of agriculture, to identify suitable treatments for the processes used.

articleTitle: Machine Learning based model to Detect Anomaly in the Water
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: The environmental impact of technology is only one area where the field is expanding rapidly without necessarily good results. [1] Water contamination is one such critical problem. Because water is essential to human survival, polluting it has serious consequences for civilization. [1] Knowing what harmful substances are in the water and being able to identify them is a crucial step toward reducing the damage they cause. While Image classification and sparse coding have been widely employed for water pollution identification [1,] they have unintended implications when applied to bacterial information detection. The current technologies used to identify contaminants in photos and water pipes, such as Convolutional neural networks (CNN), natural language processing (NLP), and the Internet of Things (IoT), are expensive and inefficient when compared to 3D microscopy data. It is a model that uses categorization and data visualization to estimate the total number of bacteria in a given environment. Accuracy scores may be seen in the model's studied graphs, decision tree, confusion matrix, and classification report. By the use of these data sets, the crucial factors for clean water were evaluated, and a model was built that can categorize the massive amounts of information, find meaningful patterns, and make reliable predictions. It has been determined which method yields the highest accuracy prediction (87<sup>%</sup>) by thoroughly analyzing the available models' accuracy scores. This study thus provides a valid evaluation of bacterial water vs unadulterated water.

articleTitle: SMS Spam Detection Using Deep Learning Techniques: A Comparative Analysis of DNN Vs LSTM Vs Bi-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: SMS spam detection is crucial for ensuring text messaging systems' security and usability. Spam messages, also known as unwanted text messages, can be a nuisance and be used for phishing scams and other malicious activities. In this research, we analyze various SMS spam detection methods and their efficiency in recognizing spam messages. Three machine learning models-LSTM, a DNN, and a Bi-LSTM model have been used to examine the data. We found that our proposed methods are highly effective at detecting spam messages with high accuracy through our experiments on a dataset of SMS text messages. Of the three models, the DNN has produced the highest accuracy of 95.6522%, followed by Bi-LSTM with an accuracy of 93.9799% and LSTM with an accuracy of 92.9766%.

articleTitle: Designing Sustainable and Eco-Friendly Lighting Solutions for Campus Safety: The Role of Concentrated Solar-powered Light Poles
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Ensuring campus safety is crucial for universities to create a secure environment for students, faculty, and staff. Inadequate lighting can pose a significant threat to campus safety. However, limited university budgets and energy shortages can make it challenging to boost campus illumination. To overcome these challenges, this paper proposes using concentrated solar-powered light poles to provide appropriate lighting while reducing long-term electricity costs and light pollution. Low-power LED light poles powered by solar cells are the main component of this solution. By using renewable energy sources like solar energy, universities can reduce their carbon footprint and contribute to a more sustainable environment. Additionally, implementing concentrated solar-powered light poles can significantly lower air pollution levels and decrease electricity expenses. This sustainable approach to campus lighting not only addresses campus safety but also aligns with the principles of sustainable and eco-friendly design. Moreover, the installation of concentrated solar-powered light poles can positively impact student learning. Adequate lighting conditions help students stay focused and motivated, leading to an improved learning experience. Using sustainable and eco-friendly lighting solutions can also serve as an example for the campus community, encouraging them to adopt environmentally conscious practices. This paper aims to comprehensively review the benefits of using concentrated solar-powered light poles as a sustainable, eco-friendly lighting design solution for campus safety.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Review of QoS Aware Load Balancing Techniques in Generic & Specific Fog Deployment Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: The integration of smart sector applications and services with fog computing paradigm, with heterogeneity of end user devices & fog nodes resulting in opening of new research dimensions for optimizing service broker policies, resource management and fog nodes efficiency. With the emergence of fog layer in new architecture, it has been expected that it will improve quality of service for delay sensitive application. Instead of transmitting enormous volumes of IoT data to the cloud, fog analyses the most response time-sensitive data nearby, at the network boundary depending on defined policy, takes action in milliseconds on IoT data and sends a set of data to the cloud for long-term archiving and study. In this paper a comprehensive review is conducted for QoS aware load balancing optimization techniques in generic and specific fog deployment scenarios like smart grid, electric vehicles, health monitoring etc, to uncover the major findings and future research areas in current 5G fog radio access network. The review is categories into different sections based on performance estimation QoS metrics, simulation assessment tools to evaluate the efficiency of various resource allocation and load balancing techniques used in fog computing.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Reducing the Intricacies of Patent Prior Art Search
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Digitalization has a significant impact on various fields, including business, research, and community. One of the areas influenced by automation is patent administration, specifically in searching for and assessing patents. Traditional methods of patent prior art search involve using Boolean logic, keywords, synonym-selection, classifiers, multilingualism, and other techniques. However, this manual process can be time-consuming and inefficient. This study explores how artificial intelligence (AI) can aid patent assessors in their prior art search by suggesting search keywords, retrieving relevant documents, ranking them, and visualizing their content. The findings reveal that AI can reduce the time and cost involved in sifting through many patents. The study highlights the importance of human-in-the-loop methods and the need for better tools that support human-centered decision-making in prior art searches.

articleTitle: Real-Time Heartbeat Sensing with Face Video using a Webcam and OpenCV
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: People's heart rates can be measured for a variety of purposes, including telemedicine, the Internet of Things (IoT), sports, security, etc. The traditional method of monitoring HR can, however, be challenging at times or it may not scale. This study offers a solution that can simultaneously assess the heart rates of various persons using live video broadcasts. By recording the color changes brought on by blood circulation in facial skin, heart rate can be measured. An indicator that correlates to heart rate is represented by the typical hue in the area of interest (ROI) selected on the face. A pulse frequency is frequently retrieved from this signal using signal processing. This method is reasonably accurate and stable. A webcam is used to simultaneously detect the faces of persons and measure their heart rates, yielding a Heart rate slip rate of 3–5 percent. Our solution uses object tracking along with face detection, which requires less computing resources and enables greater scaling.

articleTitle: Analyzing Emotional Impact of Speech Balloons on Comic Characters: A Study of Arousal Levels
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: The dialogue between the protagonists in comics, where much of the information is communicated, usually comprises speech balloons. Thus, identifying the speech balloons and connecting them to the speaker is a crucial step. The speech balloon's shape also reveals information about the speaker's emotions. The main aim of this study is to recognize the emotional arousal of the comic character with the shape of the speech balloon. To achieve this new model has been designed with a Convolutional Neural Network and SVM, which helps to detect the features and categorize them into an emotional state associated with the shape of the speech balloon. With the proposed approach the authors have achieved 92% accuracy which is comparable accuracy with the previous work. As a result of the feature selection, it was determined that the final characteristics were more useful for estimating the shape of the speech balloon. From the experimental results, it can be observed that a higher precision rate is achieved for the surprising class i.e. 92.60%, and a higher recall rate is achieved for the anger emotion class i.e. 93.10 and a higher Fl score is achieved for the polite emotion class i.e. 93%.

articleTitle: Simulation and Development of Sewage Cleaning & Monitoring Robot using IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Sewage systems play a major role in today's modern world for the transportation of sludge from source to appropriate destinations. In addition to this advantage, this systems brings with it a lot of problems as well. Such as, sludge accumulation, damaging marine wildlife, polluting the environment, Clogs and scale formation, settling of waste materials like tree branches, and plastic containers, and sewer overflow hampering the road infrastructure in the cities, ultimately causing trouble to the citizens etc. Sludge accumulation generally takes place in the sewage network. Where it becomes very important to clean the accumulation in order to ensure the proper working of these systems. At present, cleaning sewage pipelines is a tedious job in India where cheap manual labor is utilized for cleaning purposes. This practice is very harmful to humans and can even cost them their lives due to the poisonous gases present in the sewage network which are present in very high concentrations. Although multiple automated cleaning devices have been developed by scientists but either they are very costly for implementation in every part of the country or require a technically sound professional to operate them, which is not very easily available in rural parts of India. Also, these cleaning systems can only clean sludge at the manhole location and not in between two manholes, therefore, they're unreliable in conventional Indian drainage systems. The major goal of this project is to design and develop a low-cost sewage monitoring robot, which has not yet been developed in the market. This robot will initially monitor the sewage level, identify blockages, and ultimately avoid large-scale sewage issues. In addition, the cleaning system would also be installed in the robot itself, which would lower the construction cost of two separate devices. The cleaning system would be capable of removing sludge not only at the manhole location but also between two manholes, which is absent in the present cleaning systems. This way, multiple problems can be solved at once- Monitoring of sewage network in initial phases to avoid large-scale issues, an inbuilt cleaning mechanism in the monitoring robot capable of cleaning the sludge between two manholes, saving workers from being exposed to hazardous chemicals and gases by eradicating the need of manual intervention for cleaning sludge purposes in the sewage network.

articleTitle: Comparative study of SVM, KNN and Decision Tree for Diabetic Retinopathy Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: DR (Diabetic retinopathy) is a common complication of diabetes that affects the blood vessels in the retina, leading to vision impairment and blindness. To save the eyes from suffering irreparable harm, it is essential to identify and treat DR as soon as possible. The detection of DR using ML (Machine Learning) has shown encouraging results, and it has the potential to increase the precision and effectiveness of screening and diagnosis. In this study, we used a ML and CNN (Convolutional Neural Network) approach for the detection of presence of DR using retinal images. We created extracted features using a CNN model, as the convolution and pooling done by it automates the process of feature extraction. Further, we used these features to train three ML models, SVM (Support Vector Machine), Decision tree, and KNN (K-nearest neighbors) for binary classification. The overall best accuracy was given by SVM, at 99.932% during training and 94.679% during testing. It also gave the best F1-Score of 0.946. We also altered various hyperparameters, such as kernel function and degree of polynomial function for SVM, Maximum depth and leaf nodes of the Decision tree, and number of nearest neighbors considered in KNN, and checked their performance in each case.

articleTitle: Predicting Lumpy Skin Disease using Various Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: As infection with the virus of lumpy skin disease, which causes acute or subacute sickness in cattle and the population of water buffalo, poses a serious threat to the cattle industry. Machine learning models gives the direction to make ease of testing the lumpy disease. To predict Lumpy skin disease various machine learning models are available. Various parameters are considered to find out the numerous values such as accuracy, MAE, MSE and RMSE. In this paper distinguish machine learning models are considered to make prediction level high. This paper works for the different ML models on the lumpy disease prediction to forecast the cattle disease. Random forest model gives the highest accuracy which is 97.10% and poly-F is at second position which is 96.77<sup>%</sup> accuracy score. Random forest gives MAE closet value to 0 which is 0.028 that indicates the best ML model with respect to error as well. The next ML model is decision tree, the value is 0.037. For MSE value, poly-F model gives remarkable output which is 0.025 and random forest with having 0.028 value. For RMSE, poly-F model gives remarkable output which is 0.16, random forest with having 0.017 value and decision tree is at 0.19.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Speed Control System using Voice Command and Ultra Sonic Sensor Based Approaches
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: This paper represents an experimental comparison of controlling the speed of the DC motor using voice commands and ultrasonic sensor-based control. The aim of the experiment was to compare the performance of both control methods in terms of speed control, distance measurement, and precision. An Arduino microcontroller, a DC motor, a microphone, and an ultrasonic sensor were used in the experiment. The Arduino was programmed to recognize certain keywords from the voice commands and adjust the speed of DC motor accordingly, in the case of voice command-based control. Regarding the ultrasonic sensor-based control, the Arduino was programmed to gauge the distance to an object using the ultrasonic sensor, and then modify the speed of the DC motor accordingly. The outcomes demonstrated that although both control methods could handle the DC motor's velocity, the ultrasonic sensor-based control performed better in terms of precision and distance measurement. However, the voice command-based control had the advantage of being more userfriendly and intuitive. The paper includes a detailed comparison of the performance of voice command-based control and ultrasonic sensor-based controlling of speed control of DC motor. It highlights the advantages and disadvantages of each method, and it can be used as a reference for selecting the appropriate control method for a specific application.

articleTitle: Securing your network with Honeypot, Canerytokens and Docker on AWS
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Security is more important nowadays. Because the connection of every device is available on the internet. Their attacker can easily steal our credentials and Take advantage of System and misuse our secret data Like passwords, Date of birth, Etc. Honeypot is widely used technique to lure the attacker so it can be trap, then forensic can be performed. It is clear with its name first we lure attacker to believe its live system, so they can take advantage of it. Our main aim in introducing a honeypot is to provide cost-effective security over the system there we can understand and track, and monitor hacker activity using the Canary tokens using Docker on hosting on Cloud Enterprise here AWS. Although there is no guarantee that it can completely prevent security breaches, network analysis tools can serve as valuable aids for intrusion detection and network forensics. In recent times, the research community has extensively utilized these tools to investigate various network security issues, such as Internet worms, preventing spam, countering DoS attacks, and more. By analyzing network traffic, these tools can help identify anomalous activities and patterns, enabling network administrators to take appropriate measures to safeguard their systems. Ultimately, this abstract underscore the significance of honeypages and honeytokens as part of a comprehensive security strategy in today's ever-evolving threat landscape.

articleTitle: Analysis of Phase Frequency Detector & Charge Pump Switching Circuits for Frequency Synthesizer Using CMOS Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Current work describes the complete analysis of Phase Frequency Detector (PFD) as well as the Charge Pump (CP) switching circuits that can be used with the Frequency Synthesizer in phase-locked loop (PLL). The design is employed to be enforced for a frequency synthesizer that can be further utilized with digital video streams for hand-held devices. Two-phase frequency detector are projected during this work to show how the dead zone alters the working of the frequency synthesizer. The major advantage of using those two PFD is to succeed in low power consumption and the dead zone that was achieved for the current consumption. This work covers the conventional charge pump with switched current sources to excite UP and down a capacitance load. Finally, the work shows the simulation results of the PFD/CP system in typical scenario and additionally the simulation results ascertain the working of the circuit in nontypical scenario such as completely varied temperature or change in voltage.

articleTitle: Water Quality Monitoring Using Remote-Sensing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Remote sensing techniques can be used to monitor water quality characteristics, with geographic information systems (GIS) utilizing remote sensing photos and imaging analysis results as major data sources. Remote sensing is used for weather forecasting and warning of impending cyclones in India, as well as to investigate issues such as eutrophication, oil spills, desertification, air pollution, land degradation, and deforestation. To determine water quality in coastal areas, the proposed system utilizes artificial neural networks such as the Recurrent Neural Network and ARIMA using remote sensing data, and a website is created to provide weekly updates on water quality in a particular location. While water quality monitoring based on remote sensing imagery mostly uses the semi-empirical technique, this research presents a unique technique to monitor water quality by merging high spatial resolution imageries with hyperspectral imageries (HSI). This project will benefit areas close to water bodies, and residents will be made aware of water contamination issues. The proposed technique for monitoring water quality involves merging high spatial resolution imageries with hyperspectral imageries (HSI), which is a unique approach compared to the semi-empirical technique used in water quality monitoring based on remote sensing imagery. With this technique, the individuals who live near water bodies will become more aware of the water quality in their area. The proposed system utilizes artificial neural networks such as the Recurrent Neural Network and ARIMA to determine water quality in coastal areas. The algorithms used in the system have multilayer perceptron's to achieve successful results. In addition to this, a website will be created to provide weekly updates on water quality in a specific location. The use of remote sensing techniques in monitoring water quality is not limited to just coastal areas. It can also be used to investigate issues such as eutrophication, oil spills, desertification, air pollution, land degradation, and deforestation. However, the semi-empirical technique used in water quality monitoring based on remote sensing imagery has some limitations. It has poor resolution, requires a large number of people for data collection, and has time and space constraints since it cannot analyze every picture from diverse imaging settings adaptively. Overall, the proposed technique for monitoring water quality using remote sensing data and artificial neural networks is a significant advancement in the field. It has the potential to provide accurate and reliable information about water quality, which is crucial for protecting the environment and public health.

articleTitle: Floorplanning and Comparative Analysis of 16-bit Synchronous Up/Down Counter in Different CMOS Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: In the digital domain, counters are an essential sequential circuit elements. In this paper, a 16-bit synchronous up/down counter is examined at different CMOS technologies for power, delay, and area occupied by the cell. The main aim is to study the effects of different CMOS technologies on leakage power, dynamic power, delay, and chip area. After simulation, results showed that at 45nm CMOS technology, total power consumption is 75.71% less as compared to 180nm CMOS technology. In terms of cell area and delay again 45nm CMOS technology showed better results. Further, the technology scaling substantially decrease power consumption and increase the number of transistors that can be integrated into a chip.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning and Deep Learning Techniques in Text Based Emotion Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Due to social media platforms there are lots of comments every day. Generally the comments are friendly and have good intentions. But sometimes comments convey the feelings of anger, sadness, fear, etc. Negative comments provide evidence that you cannot succeed at your goals, which can also be demotivating. So our task is to predict the various emotions of the comments. For this work, machine learning like Decision Tree, Random Forest, SVM, Logistic Regression using tf-idf and count vectors based model and deep learning model have been used. Among all deep leaning model have performed better than any other machine learning models with an accuracy of 92%.

articleTitle: Enhancing Web Application Efficiency: Exploring Modern Design Patterns within the MVC Framework
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: The growing demand for web applications across various sectors has led to challenges in developing efficient and high-performance online apps. The traditional approach to web app development may struggle to meet the performance requirements of modern online applications. To address this, the Model-View-Controller (MVC) framework has become an essential tool for creating interactive online apps. While the MVC framework has limitations, several new design patterns have emerged from its architecture that offers improvements. This paper explores some of the thoroughly researched design patterns of the MVC framework. The Composite View pattern merges several views to facilitate the development of complex user interfaces, while the Intercepting Filter design pattern filters and processes requests before they reach the controller, enhancing security and speed. The Service Layer design pattern creates an abstraction layer between the data access layer and the controller to increase scalability and maintainability. Employing MVC-based design patterns can help developers enhance the functionality and efficiency of web apps, ensuring they meet the expectations of modern consumers.

articleTitle: A Product based Recommendation System for E-Commerce Sites
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Recommendation system help the customer to find best product for them. Basically recommendation system is the tools that are re-shaping the word of E-Commerce sites. It will help to people that they can find the efficient product without any constraint. In this paper we will discuss about how to recommendation system will work and also we will analyze the algorithm. The products are recommended based on the user viewing time, product rating and many more information which we will get from the client. It is basically recommendation system which is show the better product to the customer. In this paper we will review various techniques which is help us to recommend the product in very efficient way.

articleTitle: Analysing and Visualising trends for Supply Chain Demand Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Forecasting and prediction analysis have recently become a vital part of the supply chain management especially for perishable items being produced. The paper aims to deliver the importance of intervening the resources and abilities of data analysis and visualization to determine accurately the expected sales values with the supply chain management process for improving the overall business. A dataset with record of five years of actual sales data is used. On this data four prediction models- Seasonal Naïve, Holt-Winters Triple Exponential Smoothing, Seasonal ARIMA and Linear Regression, were trained and their results were analysed. Each model focused on its on characteristic way of determining outputs and were capable of overall delivering good results with error rate not exceeding 27%. The paper determines the reason behind the variations in the results and concludes with how the right forecasting model can help supply chain managers to improve the performance of the business.

articleTitle: Effectiveness of Digital Marketing to Protect Customer's Through Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: The development of technology is inseparable from the development of digital marketing. Businesses gather precise real-time customer insights and an outstanding customer experience based on artificial intelligence technology and interaction with virtual assistants. The selected articles for the review were from English-language research papers and journals on digital marketing and artificial intelligence. This study's findings demonstrate that the digital market and technology are unquestionably essential components in fostering a market environment, and that technology is consistently altering its appearance. We can assert that AI will have a vast future application that will benefit not only the digital marketing industry but also other industries. As a result, we can say that technologies have effectively impacted the digital market by facilitating smoothness, cost-effectiveness, time savings, and other benefits. Businesses can better target their customers and create campaigns that are more effective and have higher conversion rates. Increased sales and customer satisfaction can be achieved through the use of AI's prediction efficiency by marketers, who can quickly and easily identify potential customers and their purchasing habits. The speed with which artificial intelligence is being implemented across industries will undoubtedly bring about a revolution in business practices.

articleTitle: Load Balancing in Cloud Computing: A Simulation-Based Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Cloud computing has become a popular paradigm for delivering on-demand computing resources over the internet. One of the key challenges in cloud computing is load balancing, which ensures that computing resources are efficiently utilized, and applications are highly available. Load balancing is a crucial aspect of cloud computing that ensures optimal resource utilization while providing high performance to end users. This paper presents a simulation-based evaluation of three load balancing algorithms: Round Robin, Equally Spread, and Location-Aware based on four key criteria: Balancing Efficiency, Complexity, Suitability, and Fault Tolerance using the CloudAnalyst tool. We investigate the performance of these algorithms in a simulated cloud environment. Our results demonstrate that Equally Spread outperforms the other two algorithms in balancing efficiency and fault tolerance, while Location-Aware is better suited for complex cloud environments. Our simulation-based evaluation provides valuable insights into the performance of different load balancing algorithms in cloud computing environments based on key criteria. It highlights the importance of choosing an appropriate load balancing algorithm based on the application's specific requirements and the cloud environment for efficient resource utilization and improved performance.

articleTitle: Digitalized Infrastructure of Smart Homes Using Iot and Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Digitalized homes are considered “smart homes” where all of the appliances and gadgets are automatically managed from anywhere using any networked devices, such as mobile phones. In the current modern age, the idea of “smart homes” has become important for people's lifestyles. The current study focuses on the inclusion of the Internet of Things (IoT) and cloud computing which provides an enhancement in the structure of smart homes leading to low budget and effective communication within the smart home utilities. Users may get real-time information immediately through a web browser with the help of IoT and cloud computing. Based on the analysis, this study identifies the functionality of the smart equipment equipped in smart homes and their connectivity via cloud servers. Finally, based on the evaluation the challenges faced by the technology have been discussed, and based on that future recommendations have been provided according to the framework generated.

articleTitle: Detection of Plant Disease and Pests using Coherent Deep Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Recently, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) in agriculture has become the most important due to its applicability in a non-exhaustive sector of the economy. The creative approach to the introduction of agricultural technology is highly increased today. Advances in computer vision and artificial intelligence (AI) have enabled fast and efficient pest recognition algorithms. Control of diseased leaves in the cropping stage is an important step. Detecting disease at an early stage and analysing affected leaves is always beneficial for agricultural development. Similarly, pest diseases hit down the development and production of Agri based resources, so their accurate recognition is required to use pesticides and eradicate the pests. In this study we provide a transfer learning-based explanation for detecting multiple diseases in different plant selections using images of healthy and diseased plants, derived from Plant Doc dataset. This paper shows a comparative study of various YOLO versions on the PlantDoc and Our own curated Plant Disease and Pest Detection Models based on YOLO versions v7 and v8 and the ability to perform detection much faster and with higher precision than the existing models developed previously.

articleTitle: A Novel Lossless Image Compression Algorithm for Optimized Memory Storage
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Data compression is a specific and special task that goes on and on as more and more data is required to be stored in the memory. For memory usage, it is always “smaller is better”. But, of course, there is always a threshold limit which may never be broken. Saving a graphical file is always challenging task as whenever we try to compress it, there is a possibility of loss of data whether in terms of colour or in terms of sharpness. The study (algorithm) presented in this paper is a methodical formation where the size of a graphical file has been cut to half without any type of loss of information. Neither the sharpness nor the colour gets affected. Through the paper, a novel algorithm has been developed which compresses an image file to half its previous size. The best part is that the complexity of algorithm is comparatively low for compressing as well as de-compressing (re-generation) purpose.

articleTitle: A Metaheuristic Approach for the Design of Linear Phase FIR Differentiator
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: This study describes a newly developed metaheuristic optimization method known as Honey Badger Algorithm (HBA), which is employed to the design of linear phase finite impulse response (FIR) non-full band differentiator. Full-band differentiators are rarely needed in real-world applications. Most of the times, the intended frequency response characteristic just needs to be linear over the constrained frequency range. HBA imitates the honey badger's sophisticated foraging style. Additionally, it contains a powerful control parameter to provide results that are more convergent and have minimal steady state error. The HBA algorithm's efficiency is calculated for the design problem of differentiator. For comparison of different performance metrics like magnitude response and error response Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) and Artificial Bee Colony (ABC) algorithm are used as standard benchmarks. Also, one more recently developed algorithm called Moth-Flame Optimization (MFO) is used for the designing of type-3, order-26 linear phase FIR differentiator to measure its design capability.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of 16PSK-OFDM-FSO in Diverse Weather Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: One of the promising point-to-point or point-to-multipoint communication systems is Free Space Optical (FSO) systems. Due to its advantageous features, it has evolved into versatile technology for broadband access in future. With the advancements made in technology there still exists some environmental factors like fog, smog, rain, clouds, dust with other suspended particles which may cause interference of the communication channel. Further, this may affect the transceiver performance and the attenuation coefficient of the medium. Also, the increase in levels of attenuation results in increased losses and need to be carefully monitored. Therefore, to overcome these challenges faced by FSO-OFDM point to point laser communication system, 16-PSK-OFDM-FSO communication system is proposed. The proposed communication model is examined and analyzed under cloudy and rainy weather conditions. This paper thoroughly investigated and simulated the attenuation of the atmosphere under various situations and assessed the impact of these conditions. Further, the efficiency and efficacy of the proposed model is examined with the help of SNR, constellation diagrams and attenuation curves as a function of visibility. Additionally, the SNR vs. BER curve for various weather conditions showed that the value of BER decreases more for cloudy than for rainy weather reaching 10–20 for rain and 10–25 for cloud, respectively.

articleTitle: A Review on Smart Fuel Theft Prevention and Monitoring System Using Mobile Application
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: The objective of this paper is to assess the performance of a mobile application for fuel monitoring. To monitor and protect the gasoline in the automobile, the hybrid system that the Anti-Theft Safety System was developed. The technology alerts the car's owner and activates the alarm incorporated into the system using the buzzer in the case of fuel theft or gasoline leaking. Due to the increased incidence of gasoline theft in our country, the document was recognised since fuel security is of the highest significance to the society. As a consequence, as long as the GSM network is accessible, the automobile is safe wherever it is parked. This paper's primary goals are to: a) Measure the fuel levels using an ultrasonic sensor. b) Check for fuel leakage and fuel theft c) Use the mobile application to track down data on fuel consumption and theft report.

articleTitle: Cloud Security Using The Smart Contracts
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: In today's digital age, it's becoming increasingly common for individuals and businesses alike to opt for cloud-based storage over traditional on-premise storage. However, this shift towards cloud computing also brings with it a host of new security challenges. Data stored on public cloud infrastructure is susceptible to various types of vulnerabilities, threats, and attacks that can compromise its confidentiality, availability, and integrity. To address these concerns, we propose an innovative architecture that integrates multiple entities - including multiple public clouds, a private cloud, smart contracts, and the data owner, client, or user. Our decentralized cloud architecture provides a robust form of security for data by incorporating smart contracts between the data owner and the private cloud, as well as between the client and the data owner. By utilizing this approach, we can help ensure that data is protected from unauthorized access, while also providing users with a highly flexible and scalable solution for managing their data in the cloud. With our architecture, businesses and individuals can enjoy the benefits of cloud-based storage while also maintaining the highest levels of security and peace of mind.

articleTitle: Toxic H2S Gases Detection using IOT AND ANN Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Environment concerns have stirred up improved concern in the enlargement of gas detector for toxicant gases odorous detection. The appropriateness of such materials is due to less expense as compared with to other material. Gas leakage detector using gas sensorand also connect it with IoT using ESP8266 module for safety and security. IoT is currently used in development of healthcare and domestic atmosphere characteristic surveillance magnifies the international and national trade requirement for decreased gas or odorous detectors. Metal oxide gas detectors conventional utilized micro furnace invented with Micro- Electro-Mechanical System (MEMS) engineering science predominate the international and national commercialize in their balancing accomplishment presentation and low price. Gas detectors mostly implemented in various fields similar as farming, automotive industrial, smart domestic involuntary technique for domestic air characteristic and environmental monitoring. The 2% CuO dopped SnO2 based thick film invented detectors reaction with the temperature range of 150°C and 350°C for H2S toxic gas for concentration of (250 ppm-1500 ppm).

articleTitle: Impact of solar panels on the environment and its analysis at various mounting condition
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Conventional source of energy is a major source to meet the energy requirement for large population. But then again it creates environmental issues like pollution, scarcity of sources, energy imbalance,health hazards from the harmful gases and chemical released from nuclear plants. Renewable energy is a solution to all these problem as it is free and pollution free. But the construction and installation may effect environment to some extent. of these In this work impact of solar panels on the environment is discussed with its positive and negative impact and also various mounting condition is studied. The temperature of both roof mounted and ground mounted is studied and its effecton open circuit voltage and short circuit current is also analysed. It is found that there is a rise in panel temperature by 2°C to 3 °C more at roof mounted condition.

articleTitle: A high Gain Wideband Inverted E-shaped Antenna Array for 5G mmWave Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: In this communication, we have designed and compared the three modified inverted E-shaped antennas that are used to form arrays for 5G millimeter wave applications for 26 Hz and 28 GHz. A simple 1 to 8 power divider is used to feed the proposed antenna elements. The maximum bandwidth achieved in all three array configurations lies from 23.15 - 35.25 GHz, and the improvement in the gain is achieved using the modified geometry of antenna elements. The maximum gain of 11.02 dBi is achieved in the entire operating frequency band. The overall size of antenna arrays design is 56.5 mm × 24.5 mm × 1.6 mm All the proposed antenna arrays are designed on an FR4 substrate. The proposed arrays can fulfill the desired requirements for 5G communication.

articleTitle: Causal analysis of factors contributing to food wastage in restaurants of India
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: India accounts for 37% of the world's total food-insecure population. Despite this fact, food is still being wasted knowingly or unknowingly. This study identifies the factors contributing to food wastage in restaurants of India. The study is based on the survey analysis which identifies the factors contributing to food wastage in restaurants. A total of 6 factors have been identified through an extensive literature survey. The factors are analyzed to establish a causal relationship using the DEMATEL (Decision-Making Trial and Evaluation Laboratory) approach. The findings reveal that Less Shelf Life (LSL) is the most influencing factor, from the identified ones.

articleTitle: Analysis of Behavioural Data of Customer for the E-Commerce Platform by using Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: This research analyses the effect of numerous factors that allow E-commerce platforms to obtain previous knowledge about customer purchase tendencies. This research improves customer behaviour, product discoverability, and warehouse maintenance. Demanding product categories assist maintain the warehouse and generate sales ideas by offering an appropriate discount to attract consumers and promote same-day delivery. The system uses an e-commerce company database to store consumer purchase information. Our model analyses the data to classify customers and commodities. Our study includes descriptive, predictive, and prescriptive analytics to anticipate e-commerce sales. The descriptive study includes data cleaning, preprocessing, and visualization to analyze gender, city tier, spending money, age, city, marital status, financial position, brand cost, and product categories these are the attributes of dataset. To advance to predictive analytics, machine learning techniques such as naive Bayes classification, support vector classification, logistical regression, decision tree, KNN classification, and random forest classification are applied to the dataset to anticipate product sales. This proposed research reduces e-waste and promotes sustainable development by anticipating product sales.

articleTitle: Optimized Approach for Video Summarization using Transfer Learning and LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Video content has been increasing at a very high pace, so the need for summarizing videos is of urgent need. Video summarization emphasizes on quick go-through of video content. In the last few decades, the field of video summarization has inspired a lot of research. Many of the techniques have been proposed by different researchers, but most of them are not able to create summaries of general videos, i.e., they are generally suitable for a set of categories of videos. To overcome this problem, we have introduced a general framework for video summarization, where we have used a pre-trained VGG16 model for feature extraction, and based on the features, we found the frame level importance using a Long Short Term memory (LSTM) network. After that, we selected the frames with high frame-level scores and finally combined them to form the video summary. Experimenting with the different types of videos taken from the different datasets shows that the proposed methodology outperforms the existing state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: Self- Adaptive Glow Warm Swarm Optimization Technique in Optimal Feature Selection in Grading of Fruit Mango
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: An image classification hybridized approach based on CNN and Fuzzy Classifier was developed for enhancing the classification accuracy of the mango fruit. In the feature extraction, texture, geometric and color-based characteristics are applied. In feature selection Self-adaptive Glow worm Swarm Optimization is proposed (SA-GSO). In fruit maturity prediction KNN classifier is used with inclusion of SA-GSO. Finally in classification process fruit segmented image features are subjected to Fuzzy classifier and fruit segmented image is subjected to CNN. Finally generated classification results depend on results generated by fuzzy classifier and CNN. Classification of fruit mango is done in three classes: good, average and poor that is based on fruit maturity, texture and geometric features. Finally, the suggested model's assessed findings investigate a variety of defective and healthy mango images, demonstrating that when compared to other approaches in terms of diverse metrics approaches, the suggested strategy offers the highest degree of accuracy.

Author Keywords: Self adaptive glow worm swarm optimization

articleTitle: Advancing Political Bias Detection: A Novel High-Accuracy Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Media bias is a persistent departure from the core values of objectivity and accuracy in journalism. Instead of presenting the facts objectively, media outlets and reporters frequently choose the storylines and specifics that will be included in their articles. Whether established or learned, biases have the power to dramatically influence people's views and attitudes in different societies and regions, which can lead to skewed assessments. This study intends to address the issue of biased and closed-minded attitudes in the media by introducing a novel approach leveraging deep learning. This approach beats the previous state-of-the-art models on accuracy on multiple datasets to identify political bias in the media. By highlighting these biases in political reporting we aim to offer a more unbiased evaluation of media coverage.

articleTitle: Edge Computing based IDS Detecting Threats using Machine Learning and PyCaret
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: The Internet of Things is getting connected with the edge computing network day by day. These devices generate large amounts of confidential data that is stored and processed on edge computing. There is a need to protect such data and edge computing networks from new types of attacks. Therefore, intrusion detection system (IDS) is an effective defense to secure edge computing network. In this study, an IDS based on machine learning is designed and developed. This article elaborates the technique of Recursive Feature Elimination (RFE) using the Random Forest algorithm (RF). The contribution of this paper is to select a relevant and efficient feature set using the recently developed Python library PyCaret. This paper proposes a novel approach for detecting new types of attacks in network traffic. The recently released dataset CICIDS2017 has been used to evaluate the proposed method, which includes state-of-the-art attacks. In this paper, two classification techniques are also used to build the IDS model. The first is a binary classification technique using the recently developed PyCaret library, and the second is a multiclass classification technique using RFE.

articleTitle: A Study on Secure Quantum Computing for Healthcare System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Medical care system broadly use Information technology (IT) for framework confirmation (advanced marks), web surfing, messages, texting, safeguarding information very still, Voice over Web Convention (VoIP) communication, and cell communication. To safeguard patient ID and medical care data, cryptographic frameworks are broadly used to get these information from malignant outsiders (fraud). In present healthcare system, we noticed sensible progress in productive stockpiling of the data of patients and their family, in its opportune recovery, and guaranteeing its wellbeing from enemies. Be that as it may, the information are expanding quickly and the ongoing computational frameworks could lack in the near future. Quantum computing examination could prompt “quantum jumps,” and it could have unexpected repercussions in the clinical field. This method can possibly be utilized in an expansive scope of settings, where some incorporate the improvement for novel medications, the personalization of clinical medicines, and increased efficiency of DNA sequencing. This Research paper will enlighten us on how Q.C is changing things all over Healthcare Industry and help understand why it's important to go for Q.C rather than Current Technology.

articleTitle: Menstrual Cycles Prediction using Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: The objective of this research is to examine the feasibility of forecasting the start date of a woman's menstrual cycle using self-recorded cycle data. The study takes into consideration the unique physiological patterns of a woman's menstruation to deliver personalized predictions. Our goal is to create a model that utilizes the individual's menstrual cycle information and population-based data to produce customized predictions unique to each woman. The main feature of this model is its ability to provide personalized predictions based on an individual's menstrual cycle patterns. The methodology employed in this project involves the use of Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs). The model's predictive performance is evaluated by comparing the outcome with the mean values of all menstrual cycles. The results indicate high accuracy, with an R<sup>2</sup>value of 98.08% and a Mean Squared Error of 1.92%. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of the ANN s in modeling the patterns of a woman's menstrual cycle and the potential for personalized predictions based on self-tracked cycle data.

articleTitle: Bioinformatic Analysis of BRCA for Breast, Ovary and Lung Cancer
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: The two most well-known genes inculpated in transcriptional control and DNA repair are breast cancer 1 and breast cancer 2, which are connected to breast tumor, ovarian tumor, and also to lung tumor. In order to elucidate mechanisms by which BRCA genes ultimately lead to the development of breast, ovarian, or lung tumors, the current study set out to clarify the expression patterns, mutational patterns, and interaction pathways of BRCA1 and BRCA2. So here in this paper bioinformatics tools have been used to analyse these two genes. FIREHOSE analysis was done to check messanger RNA levels. Breast cancer and Breast cancer 2 mutations were checked using cBioPortal study. A KM plotter study was completed to ascertain the predictive role of these genes in the chosen cancer type. After this box plot and stage plot analysis done with GEPIA2 database to check expression in four stages and for a comparison between normal tissue and tumoric tissue.
