STRING analysis done to show functional interaction between proteins

articleTitle: Evaluation Of The Efficiency Of Honeypots In Opposing Flooding Attack
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: The significance of internet security cannot be overstated for both individuals and organizations, given the increasing threat of malicious cyber-attacks. To enhance internet security, implementing honeypot system is a practical solution. A honeypot is a highly effective security forensic solution that minimizes the possibilities of intrusion and detects potential security vulnerabilities within a system This paper gives a thorough analysis of honeypots and various attack types, and it emphasizes how they may be used to increase the security of a company and its vital network systems. This study uses a pent box honeypot to evaluate the honeypot system's defense against flooding attacks and look at the recorded intrusion attempts. Honeypots, which serve as a line of defense for our networks, have shown to be a successful method of increasing internet security. The study uses the Pent Box tool to deploy honeypots, test them against syn assaults, and analyse the results based on log data. Honeypots can lessen computer network threats and give significant statistics about probable system security holes.

articleTitle: Automated Surveillance and Bomb Diffusing System for Military Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Terrorism is a major threat to any country's growth. Terrorism can take many forms like ethno- nationalist terrorism, religious terrorism, left-wing terrorism, and narco-terrorism. In general, Terrorism disturbs human rights and it affects the health and wealth of any country. One form of terrorism is the planting of dangerous bombs in places where people gather in large amounts. These acts will create big damage to the lives and the properties of society. All Governments have bomb diffusion squad in their military team who will risk their lives in diffusing the planted bombs. They generally wear bomb-diffusing suits, and helmets before diffusing. But if the bomb explodes, their suits and helmets cannot protect them fully. They may lose their lives orbecome disabled. Here, we have designed a very low-costsurveillance and bomb-diffusing robot. This robot will become an extra layer of protection between the bomb and the squad. The main advantage lies in the dualpurpose. The first one is it will detect the bomb and the second one is it can be used for surveillance using the cameras in the robot. Any suspicious packetsfound can be easily checked for bombs using the designedwork

articleTitle: Impact Of Social Media Apps On Public Health: An Overview with Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Social media has grown to be a significant element of modern life and has both beneficial and harmful effects on people's health. Several parents and activists have recently voiced their worries about the potentially negative influence of social media use. Some research indicates that using social media would use very well result in poor mental health outcomes including suicidality, loneliness, and a significant decrease in empathy. Other trials either didn't establish any risk or suggested that some people might be benefited from social media. Amongst the consequences of high usage of Social media, mental illness, panic disorder, and diminished tolerance is being increased. According to the findings of different age groups concluded that it is giving several advantages but it is harmful also so in this research, an analysis is being done of social media usage in several generations. However, unclear registration revealed lifelong suicidal ideation, demonstrating that this particular posture may be a sign of more serious issues. This research focuses on how social media affects people's life.

articleTitle: Future's Backbone Network Monitoring With Metadata in Data Warehouse for Telecom Industry
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: This paper presents Data flow from the backbone network to the data warehouse for tomorrow's network monitoring by real-time data analysis with metadata quality management for the Telecom industry. Real-time data are collected from backbone devices to the staging server's SFTP location from Incidence Monitoring tools (Which are directly or indirectly connected from backbone devices by SNMP). Metadata management is a central part of the data analysis process. Metadata may contain information about the schema of the data so that the data can be transformed into quarriable data objects when required.

articleTitle: Mouth Ulcer Detection using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Globally, 177,384 persons lost their lives to oral cancer the bulk of these fatalities occurred in economically developing countries in 2018. Low-cost and early disease detection may be made possible by enabling automation in the detection of oral lesions that may or may not be malignant. A significant collection of thoroughly annotated oral lesions is essential. Diagnosing oral lesions can be challenging since they have many visible and shared external characteristics. For identifying the type of oral ulcer in this experiment, Inception ResnetV2, DenseNET, and Resnet 50 were recommended. Deep neural network-based automated systems were also employed to derive sophisticated patterns for tackling this difficult problem. The computerized observation and categorization of aphthous ulcer using duplet deep learning-based computer vision techniques was tested on the study's initial data collection. Our three algorithms have been used to evaluate lesions for early oral cancer research using a collection of photos. On the basis of the study's initial data, two deep learning-based approaches-image classification with our three algorithms-were assessed for the automated detection of oral cancer. Our early results demonstrate that deep learning can successfully complete this challenging task.

articleTitle: Reliance Stock Market Analysis with RBF Kernel using Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: This paper analyzes stock market prediction using Machine Learning Techniques with varied algorithms. Financial prediction experts consider stock market forecasting to be a difficult endeavor. Different models of Supervised machine learning are used for the prediction of stock prices including the RBF Kernel Model of SVM. In SVM (support vector machines) Linear, polynomial, and RBF models are used. The reliance industry dataset has been used to train the models. After the implementation of SVM highest accuracy is provided by the RBF model which is 95% accuracy. In conclusion, results provided by the RBF model can be preferred for investment, Meanwhile, linear and polynomial models are also used which gave an accuracy of 94% and 93%, and are suitable for investing purposes.

articleTitle: Clustering of Hyperspectral Images using Entropy based Multiple Features (Bands) Set Selection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: This study suggests a novel segmentation-based clustering algorithm that applies entropy based local feature selection to choose the top bands for each cluster. A framework with numerous steps constitutes the proposed methodology. k-means is initially used as an image segmentation technique. Then, Shannon Entropy is utilized to determine the significant clusters from the generated segments. Finally, cluster map is obtained after merging insignificant clusters into significant clusters. Further, multiple feature set obtained through entropy are also utilized while performing clustering. The performance of the proposed methodology is examined using three sets of hyperspectral images. Adjusted Mutual Information and Overall Accuracy are used as evaluation criteria. The results of the study demonstrate that the proposed methodology performs better than the other segmentation methodologies that were evaluated. The results indicate that accuracy is much enhanced by selecting multiple feature set while performing clustering.

articleTitle: Garbage Classification with Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: With growing populations across the world and high consumption of goods and services, many problems arise with respect to waste management and dumps. The waste, if burned emits harmful fumes, and if not sorted properly, can lead to avoidable pollution due to loss of recyclable material. There is no active mechanism geared towards sorting and sifting through the waste generated, proper treatment and recycling of which can be beneficial to both the environment and governments. In order to provide a viable solution to the problem of manual classification and its costs, both human and monetary, we propose an automation system for detecting, sorting and classifying recyclable waste. If scaled for practical use, this can have a long-lasting impact on our relationship with the waste we generate. In this paper, we try to identify waste objects and classify them into categories by making use of Deep Learning techniques, Convolution Neural Networks, ResNet50, MobileNetV2, DenseNet, and other viable techniques and comparing the final results thus achieved.

articleTitle: Designing Transmit Radar Waveforms for Pulse Compression Using Classical Orthogonal Polynomials to Mitigate Side-Lobes
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Transmitting waveforms plays a significant role in radar system. The benefits of both long and short duration pulses are achieved using pulse compression technique. Radar waveforms performance is observed using matched filter response. Practically, the matched filter response consists of higher range side-lobes which creates accurate detection problem. On the other side, wider bandwidth is much desirable for a better range resolution. Therefore, waveforms are to be designed in such a way that offers mitigation in matched filter side-lobes having wider bandwidth. Using classical orthogonal polynomials, new radar waveforms are designed for transmission purposes. The performance of different order polynomials are analyzed and finally, choose that polynomial which offers wider bandwidth and significant side-lobes reduction in pulse compression radar. The designed waveform performances are compared with the existing linear frequency modulated (LFM) waveforms.

articleTitle: Image Generation from Random Noise using Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN) are an exciting and rapidly changing field that promises to generate realistic samples across a range of domains. They generate new and unique images that have never been seen before, opening a wide range of creative applications, such as in art and design, where they can be used to create novel and mind-blowing visual content. In this research paper, we test a GAN model that intakes random noise and creates realistic output images. The generator generates new images from random noise while updating its weights on the basis of whether the discriminator can be fooled to predict the generated images as real ones. We modeled the architectures for the generator and discriminator and evaluated the model on two datasets, the Simpson faces dataset and the Abstract paintings dataset. We study the results generated from the two datasets to understand the type of data suitable for quality image generation. The datasets vary in terms of feature simplicity and size. Learning curves for both datasets showing model losses have been plotted. Batches of images produced by training both datasets have been analyzed to state which one gives the best results. It was found that images with simple features perform better when trained on GANs compared to images containing randomness and difficult-to-learn features. Overall, the research demonstrates the versatility and effectiveness of GANs for image generation from random noise and also provides insights into the current situation of the state-of-the-art in this field.

articleTitle: Virtual Screening and Molecular Docking Analysis of Phytochemicals Derived from Woodfordia Fruticosa To Delineate Acinetobacter Baumannii OXA-23 Antagonists
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Carbapenem resistant Acinetobacter baumannii, a leading contributor to nosocomial infections, is an alarming vulnerability to global population and modern healthcare systems. With expediated emergence of resistance, it has emanated as an obstinate opportunistic pathogen with high morbidity and mortality rates. Of several challenging and diverse resistance mechanisms possessed by the bacteria, OXA-23 carbapenemases are the cornerstone against carbapenems, the first line antibiotics against multidrug resistant strains. Given the paucity of available therapeutics, identification of novel antimicrobial agents is an urgent necessity to tackle this notorious pathogen. Phytochemicals because of their natural origin and low toxicities have gained immense popularity as enhancers or alternatives to existing antibiotics. This study intends to widen the scope of interventions against A. baumannii OXA-23. We performed molecular docking analysis using Autodock Vina to curate the phytochemical profile of an herbal plant Woodfordia fruticosa to predict their binding affinity towards OXA-23. Sixteen molecules exhibited higher binding affinities than the standard inhibitor used (Avibactam: -6.4 kcal/mol). The shortlisted molecules were further assessed for their drug likeliness properties via RO5 analysis and prediction of bioavailability and bioactivity scores. Maslinic acid and Oleanolic acid were the top lead molecules with binding energies as high as 9.4 kcal/mol and -9.0 kcal/mol respectively.

articleTitle: Role of Artificial Intelligence to address Cyberbullying and Future Scope
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Technology has become an important facet in every field. There is risk and challenge evolved through technology. Cyberbullying is an important concern in technological development. In the past ten years, cyberbullying has been recognized as a significant issue affecting young people. This paper summarizes recent research and addresses broader ideas. It addresses definitional issues like repetition and power imbalance, as well as different types of cyberbullying, age, and gender differences, overlap with traditional bullying, distinctions between cyberbullying and traditional bullying, the causes and effects of cyber victimization, coping mechanisms, and prevention and intervention options. This study emphasizes how Artificial intelligence can address cyberbullying issues in society. The study finds out problems regarding cyberbullying, role of AI in bullying and future recommendation. Society is victimized by these issues which are increasing day by day. The study emphasized a proposed model for addressing issues with the help of AI. The study emphasized futuristic challenges about cyberbullying.

articleTitle: Exploratory Testing of Software Product Linesusing Distance Metrics
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Quality is very important in any software product, so that the customer trusts the efficiency of the product. The quality or validity of a product is measured by its testing. The test measures the quality of a product as well as shows the validity of the product. For example, testing and measuring the validity of a product in a single software system is not easy. Similarly, the software product line, which produces many different products of the same family at once, makes it even more difficult to check their validity and quality. Several techniques and models have been proposed to test the validity of the software line products and to ascertain the quality. In the same direction, we also propose a method for testing the products of software product line. The proposed method isbased on the distance between the features of the product (Desired and Original). We have used the proposed technique on product line with less features and found that the method presented gives fast and better results than traditional methods.

articleTitle: Language Identification using Multi-Layer Perceptron
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Speech-based language identification is one of the most promising areas. Language identification is the strategy for perceiving a particular language from short speech data. The wording of Telugu, Hindi, and English falls within this work's purview of language identification. Accuracy is the primary language identification problem in the literature. This study proposes a multi-layer perceptron with a sequential model where every epoch uses the Adam Optimizer to lower the error rate and boost accuracy. Mel Frequency Cepstral Coefficient is also utilized to separate highlights from sounds. With 85% accuracy, the proposed language identification model surpassed competing models in the literature.

articleTitle: Efficient Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing: A Framework for Automation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Due to a variety of factors, the number of computers connected to the internet has been growing exponentially. The dependence that resulted from this exponential growth has profound cybersecurity consequences. The main implication is that cybercrime is increasing exponentially, making vulnerability assessment and penetration testing (VAPT) necessary. Penetration testing and vulnerability assessment can balance any responsibility connected with a successful attack on an organization's assets. The present frameworks and tools for VAPT are primarily manual and demand very high specialist knowledge. Additionally, several systems on the market only automate specific VAPT processes, not the entire procedure. This discrepancy offers the chance to develop a solution by fully automating the procedure while minimizing the required level of knowledge. As a result, this paper offers an updated automated system for usage by both beginners and cybersecurity experts. Additionally, it offers a framework for business use that makes use of multi-agent systems and some elements of full stack monitoring.

articleTitle: Detection of Faulty node with Hybrid Machine Learning using SVM model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: The huge volume of data generated these days from a wide variety of sources has contributed to the widespread use of distributed data processing methods. In today's sophisticated huge computing systems, occupations are broken down into multiple smaller tasks that are carried out in parallel in order to improve work learning results and minimise consumption. Nevertheless, responding with straggler processes, which are processes that run slowly and contribute to an increase in the overall response time, is a common performance problem in such platforms. In this research, we suggested utilizing a hybrid machine learning approach to find struggler nodes in a large distributed environment. These nodes would be identified by their inability to successfully complete tasks. In this paper, we proposed a hybrid machine learning model for detecting faulty nodes in large distributed machines with collaboration of reinforcement and supervised machine learning. The large Virtual Machine (VM's) log data has been collected from the distributed environment and proceeded with reinforcement learning algorithm for module training and supervised machine learning for module testing. According to extracted features, reinforcement learning encompasses an activation function that generates the label for the respective node, whether healthy or weak. In the testing phase, the natural world VM's log data has been collected and evaluated with supervised machine learning classifiers. Several machine learning classification algorithms have evaluated and acquired the results. The SVM provides higher accuracy over the other machine learning classifiers with our reinforcement learning model.

articleTitle: An Energy-efficient Ferry-based Routing Algorithm for Scattered FANET Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Flying ad hoc networks (FANETs), have a wide range of applications in both civilian and military settings. Although, prevailing routing protocols are effective in well-connected networks, they struggle in sparse networks. To address this issue in FANETs, a new geographic routing method, utilizing a delay-tolerant routing protocol, is proposed in this paper. The proposed method combines position routing and delay tolerant network (DTN) to minimize routing errors. Here, beacons are transmitted by unmanned aerial vehicles (UA Vs) acting as ferries to inform about their succeeding anchor position to other nodes. The node receiving the beacon determines the closest ferry node and base station to the destination. Using the store-carry and forward approach, each node in the network handles sparse networks. Here, we focused to achieve low latency and have developed a novel communication protocol with two options to emphasize the need for lower latency and routing overhead when delivering data. Data collected by searching UAVs is sent to the base station using the ferry. The proposed model is validated using simulated scenarios, which show improved packet delivery, decreased end-to-end delay, and decreased overhead. The study highlights the importance of using communication methods that have lower latency and routing overhead to deliver data efficiently.

articleTitle: Mathematical modelling of non-feedback and feedback modes within eIF2 machinery: Limited data aided with well-studied in-vivo system of yeast
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: The mechanism of protein synthesis in eukaryotes relies on biochemical reactions and universally conserved factors such as initiation (eIFs), elongation (eEFs), release factors (eRFs), and more. Eukaryotic initiation factor 2 (eIF2) is one of the essential factors for the initiation of protein synthesis. In this study, for the analysis of eIF2 dependent translational initiation, a mathematical model representing all core elements required for eukaryotic translation initiation machinery is considered. Further in-silico analyses and comparisons of two distinct modes of phosphorylation i.e. non-feedback and feedback modes are also discussed. In the proposed model, when the eIF2 kinase activates, the translation stops within a few minutes; in addition, despite having limited access to quantitative data, the model can reach a steady state of translational activity at levels very similar to a well-studied in-vivo system (yeast).

articleTitle: Data Delivery Incorporating Blockchain in Vanet Simulation Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: A Vehicular Ad-hoc Network is an experimental approach for sending or receiving data or messages for secure driving. While sharing data, attacks can occur using malware. To avoid this there is a need for an algorithm that must be unbreakable. Hence with help of Blockchain, every vehicle can share its location with the nearby nodes so that if any malfunction occurs it can be removed. The proposed work is done with one of the consensus algorithms of Blockchain called PROOF of LOCATION. The VANET simulation is done with MATLAB simulator. The data shared will be protected with the help of the Secure Hash Algorithm (SHA-1). As a result, the VANET environment is created and all the information is stored in a cloud server. Finally, all nodes can view the shared location with related packet information such as speed, location and processing time. Hence the results achieve better performance by reducing error and delay and thereby can share location securely between vehicles.

articleTitle: Automated Drowsiness Detection for Driver Safety: A Deep Learning-based Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Road accidents are the most common cause of death and severe injuries today. Approximately 1.25 million people died worldwide from road accidents last year, and around 1.5 lakh people died in India [13]. The reason for many of these accidents is driver fatigue. In this paper, we have proposed a drowsiness detection system using different deep-learning algorithms. We used specific computer vision techniques to extract the facial features and later analyzed them to detect drowsiness precisely. We have compared the output of all two deep learning algorithms, i.e., CNN (Convolutional Neural Network) and MLP (Multilayer Perceptron), based on the metrics values, including accuracy, sensitivity, roc curve, F1 score, and specificity. The most efficient model in our research was MLP, with an accuracy of 86%. The suggested automated drowsiness detection system appears to be a promising and efficient solution to promote driving safety. The proposed model highlights the power of deep learning methods to tackle practical issues in detecting drowsiness in drivers.

articleTitle: Machine Learning based Self Driving Car Simulator along with Graphic User Interface (GUI)
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: This paper demonstrates a self-driving car simulator using machine learning along with Graphic User Interface (GUI). The car components with their corresponding physics, road structuring, traffic patterns, and neural network for predicting the next movement stage are realized using JavaScript programming. The GUI of the developed car simulator looks like the drone is filming it from the top of the car. The car has several sensors that can cast rays to detect objects. The distance metric obtained from the sensors is then fed to a neural network that will control the car's movement. The collision detection algorithm, a polygon intersection, uses segment intersection and linear interpolation to get the coordinates of the nearby objects. The segment intersection method works on any shape of objects and orientation in o(n2) time complexity that works in the developed simulation consistently. By enabling the testing of various scenarios and control improvements, the simulation model of a self-driving car is created that replicates the operation of a physical car driver using randomly generated weights and biases of neural networks. Here, the neural network provides evidence for decision-making so that the car can drive itself reliably. The developed model works on the traffic patterns it was trained in and can be further meshed together in the future with the help of different traffic pattern models to achieve higher safety requirements.

articleTitle: A Fast RNS Processor for Moduli Set {2n+1, 2n, 2n-1}
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Residue Number System (RNS) can perform subtraction, addition independently with borrow-free and carry-free propagation. To convert binary to residues and residues to binary, forward conversion and reverse conversion are used. In this paper new mod adder structures were proposed for the mod values (2n - 1) and (2n + 1), these mod adders provide outputs for all cases. A new forward converter has been proposed with the help of newly proposed mod adders to reduce the power, delay, and area than existing design. At the end of this paper deals with designing of RNS processor for error detection and correction in communication systems. These designs have been simulated using NC Launch - Encounter tool in Cadence.

articleTitle: Classification of Insect Pest Species using CNN based Models
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: The group of animals that is considered to be the most diverse on this planet are insects, with an estimate of 5.5 million to 10 million species. Insects falling under the category of pests are the focus of this paper. Pests transmit and carry various diseases that are harmful not only for the crops but also for the population that is consuming them. Hence, early recognition of these insect pests is essential. In this paper, IP102 dataset is being used, which is a collection of insect pest species. The IP102 dataset consists of 102 species, having more than 75,000 images. Five different pre-trained Deep Learning models, namely, DenseNet-169, MobileNetV2, ResNeXt-50, VGG-16, and VGG-19 are being used in this paper. The performance of these models is then being evaluated on IP102 dataset for the identification of insect pest species. The accuracy of each model achieved is further compared to obtain the one with optimal performance.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Modern Airline Baggage Tracking System Using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Increasing number of cases of theft and mishandled luggage at the airport is the common problem faced by the customers of the airport and to provide them latest facilities it's important to meet the security challenges. This is a reason behind that the system needs to be updated in order to overcome these issues. The RFID technology/tracker which is already in operation nowadays at airport does not survey or are able to detect the possibilities of error. The GPS and GSM Module have been merged in a system of tracking to keep it actively always connected. For processing the information an Arduino microcontroller has been used in the system. Block chain technology is used to enhance the security and to store the data of the passengers in a more secure or protected way. Blockchain technology is used for handling the baggage in a transparent and convenient way at the airport. It will make sure that the passenger would get the live tracking information about their respective luggage. Block chain is connected to RFID (Radio Frequency Identification) technology for the smooth detection and tracing of the luggage and shows the clear visibility across the luggage journey. The proposed system will be highlighting on increasing the inspection of the details compared to the ongoing proctoring system which will help for real time tracking of the luggage of the clients.

articleTitle: Revitalizing Traditional Health Practices with HealingHands: An AI powered Chatbot
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: This paper presents the design and development of an AI-driven Chatbot, HealingHands, with the goal of giving tailored health advice to those looking for natural alternatives for their health complications. Based on their symptoms and personal health profile, the HealingHands is meant to give users with evidence-based recommendations on home remedies for a wide range of health concerns. The paper then discusses the home remedy chatbot's development and deployment, including its functionality, design, and testing. The study also looks into the chatbot's effectiveness in offering individualised health advice and increasing customer happiness. The findings of the study imply that the Health Bot (Healing-Hands) is a beneficial tool for those seeking natural solutions for their health conditions. The study concludes with a discussion of the findings' implications for the future of chatbot technology in healthcare, as well as the possible advantages of incorporating natural medicines into standard medical care.

articleTitle: Blockchain and its applications in Intellectual Property Rights Management
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: The decentralized, unbiased and immutable property of the blockchain systems provide security and transparency and due to this very fact, these systems are highly feasible to get attention from the legal authorities to get a substantial legal status where in these systems would be put to use in different aspect where blockchain might produce a substantial result. The judicial system might take a few years for the official procedures to accomplish, but the future withholds blockchain technology for a new generation. The counterfeit transaction detection mechanism in blockchain based systems is the key highlight that proves the existence and uniqueness of the copyrighted work. The EUIPO (European Union Intellectual Property Office) has also recognized the potential of the systems to devalue the counterfeiting mechanism to bypass the system. In order to increase its popularity, the organization has also decided to organize a blockchain hackathon aimed at proof of concepts wherein next level infrastructure is being built to combat the counterfeit transactions.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Optimized Low Power Pre-Charge Sense Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: In recent time Researchers and VLSI designers are very concerned with low energy consumption because of the exponential improvement in nanoscale technologies. In this proposed research, a stack-based low power reduction technique has been applied in charge sense amplifier utilising the Cadence tool in standard gpdk 45nm technology documentation. Power dissipation of specific sense amplifier topology is the main topic of observations. According to the outcomes of the simulation, the modified charge sense amplifier consumes 123.5094 pW of power. In addition, the proposed application of the stack-based technology in charge sense amplifier results in a reduction of power dissipation by 10-50<sup>%</sup> when the power supply voltage is 1.8V.

articleTitle: Improving Vehicle Detection using Ghost Convolution and GhostBottleneck layers in YOLOv5s
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: In the view of large number of vehicles on the road, manually controlling vehicles become very difficult and automated traffic management system is a need. Vehicle detection is necessary for automatic traffic management to accurately monitor and control the flow of traffic. In this paper we propose an improved YOLOv5s model for vehicle detection. It uses GhostConv and Ghostbottleneck as part of the architecture. One of the main benefits of this model is that it reduces the number of parameters, which can lead to faster training and inference times. Adapting the GhostConv and GhostBottleneck in model, reduces the amount of calculation, which makes the model faster. For training of models we make a traffic vehicles dataset that consist of four classes: auto, bike, car and bus. The experimental results show that the new model is able to reduce the number of parameters generated by 61.6% which also reduces the computation time of model. This model is also able to perform better as compared to original YOLOV5s.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison of Various Optimization Techniques for ECG Signals
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Feature extraction from the ECG (Electrocardiogram) data is a most important phase for the identification of heart diseases. As a result, the value of the ECG categorization approach in the present medical world is quite high. Many machine learning programmes are available that may be used to classify and analyse ECG data. The primary flaw in most ECG classification methods is that they have non-optimized capabilities for unstructured function learning frameworks. The problem originates from the lack of methods that might accurately handle the task of ECG categorization. The use of optimisation algorithms coupled with the deep learning idea is the apparent answer among the different strategies that are now accessible. The crucial part is figuring out the right R-peaks and RR intervals. In the suggested study, performance metrics of various meta heuristic optimisation techniques i.e. Cuckoo search along with Support Vector Machine(SVM), Sine Cosine Algorithm (SCA) and Linear Adaptive Sine Cosine Algorithm(LA-SCA) are compared. To assess and train the system, signal data is used from the MIT-BIH arrhythmia database. The main goal of this paper is to obtain information about various arrhythmia classes. Considering accuracy and precision as performance parameters, the comparison of above said algorithms is presented.

articleTitle: Indian National Stock Exchange Crude Oil (CL=F) Close Price Forecasting Using LSTM and Bi-LSTM Multivariate Deep Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Predictive analysis of crude oil prices is very much required as worldwide economy depends on it. In this paper, time series based predictive analysis is implemented to predict crude oil prices in Indian national stock exchange. A real time online data source was utilized for collecting till date data starting from 2002. LSTM and Bidirectional-LSTM based multivariate algorithms were applied to analyze and predict future trends and predictions of fuel prices. Analyzed results on crude oil price prediction revealed Bi-LSTM as a better technique in comparison to LSTM.

articleTitle: TDP-43 Inhibitors in Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis: An Application of Drug Repurposing Approach Using FDA-Approved Drugs
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: A motor neuron disease, Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS) causes the continuous decline in the functioning of neurons resulting in the symptoms like muscle cramps, weak muscles, difficulty in chewing and swallowing, muscle twitches, and unusual fatigue in limbs eventually resulting in paralysis. Being a Neurodegenerative Disorder (NDD), complete treatment is still not present. Studies provide some treatments and medications to slow down the progression of the disease and in the current era, based on the mechanisms of ALS several insillco studies are resulting in repurposed drugs that can be used for the treatment of the disease. These drugs can be used for further clinical research. In this paper, a list of FDA-approved drugs has been used to find a potential inhibitor for the treatment of ALS by inhibiting the mechanism of Transactive response DNA binding Protein (TDP-43). The entire work is based on the in-silico studies and drug repurposing approach. Abiraterone acetate resulted as the best binding drug with a binding affinity of -9. 1kcal/mol. Along with this drug, 9 more best-binding drugs were listed which can be repurposed for the inhibition of TDP-43 to slow down the progress of ALS.

articleTitle: Analysis of Land Surface Temperature at 10-meter Pixel size (Spatial Resolution) for Ahmedabad City
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Land surface temperature (LST) is one of the most important factors in the urban studies as it provides significant information about the thermal attributes of urban area. It is important for determining energy consumption as well as monitoring urban growth and development, comprehending the urban heat island effect, and other related issues. Since urban surfaces exhibit higher levels of spatial variability, for instance, due to variations in the materials and vegetation cover, a road surface in an urban location may have a greater temperature than an adjacent green space or aquatic body. Therefore, obtaining LST with a higher spatial resolution is essential. For thermal analysis, thermal infrared satellite imagery from multispectral scanners is employed, however it typically has a lower spatial resolution. This limits the uses of such thermal sensors in complex urban landforms. This study explores the estimation of LST at 10-m spatial resolution over Ahmedabad, Gujarat. We first obtained the NDVI, NDWI, and NDBI at 30m spatial resolution from Landsat-8(L8) together with the same spectral indices from Sentinel-2(S2) in order to determine the LST at 10m spatial resolution. To downscale the LST at 10 m, three spectral indices (NDVI, NDBI, and NDWI) produced by L8 and S2 were used in conjunction as predictors with LST as the predicted variable. A method based on fitting a linear relationship equation with different correlation coefficients was used to complete this operation. Thus LST at a spatial resolution of 10 m was computed using LST at 30 m cell size. The approach was integrated on Google Earth Engine, a cloud based platform which allows processing and analysis of geospatial data. To validate our findings we used two reference data sheets (a) RSLab for the validation of LST at 30-m and (b) Datasets by Power Data Access Viewer for the validation of LST at 10-m. RMSE values of 1.41 for the first case and 1.07 for the second, was observed.

articleTitle: Land Area Measurement System Design using Fastrax UP501 GPS Receiver Module
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Land area measurement is now commonly required in various professions, such as agriculture and construction. For this, varieties of traditional and modern procedures are employed. Traditional processes are time-consuming and inaccurate, and they might lead to measurement errors. New methods are faster and more precise, but they are generally more expensive, and few of them needs internet access. As a result, an alternative method for measuring land area is needed. The GPS (Global Positioning System) has the potential to measure land area. GPS is a faster, more precise, simple to use, and more cost-effective denouement than any other currently available option. This research aims to develop a battery-operated easy portable GPS that can accurately measure the land area in a short amount of time, at a low cost, and with ease of use. Fastrax UP501B GPS receiver module is used in the proposed system to measure with high position accuracy.

articleTitle: Forex trend analysis using RNN and LSTM models: Predictive analytics through neural networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Machine learning can be of excellent help to traders and organizations by presenting them with enhanced facts on future developments, permitting them to make better funding or trading choices. A good return also a boost to the economic development of the country. This research paper will study the accuracy of neural network techniques, such as LSTM and RNN models, in predicting the value of INR in comparison to USD using historic statistics. The effects of our analysis imply that both RNN and LSTM can predict efficiently. However, we found that RNNs performed better than LSTMs in terms of accuracy. Finally, the RNN model finished with a prediction accuracy of 99.893%, at the same time as the LSTM model executed with an accuracy of 99.365%.

articleTitle: Implementation of Genetic Algorithm for Detecting and Eliminating Blackhole Attack in Vehicular Ad-Hoc Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: One of the popular networks highly used for creating various Adhoc network applications is Mobile Ad hoc Networks, which are vulnerable to various security attacks, one of which is the blackhole attack. One of the networks that come under MANET is the Vehicular Adhoc network. It uses multi-hop data transmission, which provides various pathways to malicious attacks. One of the attacks, non-identifiable easily, is a blackhole attack, a category of DoS attack. Earlier research methods provided different algorithms for identifying and detecting individual attacks or standard security methods. At the same time, the accuracy of malicious activity detection and elimination is not up to the mark. In which a malevolent node misleadingly publicizes itself as having the shortest path to a destination, causing other nodes to send their data to it, which the attacker discards. This paper proposes a genetic algorithm-based approach for detecting blackhole attacks in VANETs. Our approach uses a combination of network metrics, such as network throughput and end-to-end delay, and genetic algorithms to identify malicious nodes. The genetic algorithm is used to optimize the selection of network metrics and determine the weights given to each metric in the detection process. Simulation results show that our approach effectively detects blackhole attacks with high accuracy and low false positive rates.

articleTitle: Stub-based Monopole Antenna for RFID Reader and Wireless Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: This article investigates on a stub-based wideband monopole antenna inteded for RFID reader and other wireless applications. The planar antenna comprises of two components such as the stub-based radiator fed by microstrip inset feeding and a partial ground plane. The suggested design occupies an operational -10 dB bandwidth in the two different frequency range of 3.27-3.42 GHz and 3.55-6.60 GHz. The simulated realized gain is 2.55 dBi in the operating bands. The structure is linearly polarized and has an overall dimension of 0.33λ × 0.22λ×0.014λ (λ represents the wavelength at 3.33 GHz). The proposed design can be suitable for RFID reader and wireless applications.

articleTitle: Image Processing based Image to Cartoon Generation: Reducing complexity of large computation arising from Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: This paper proposes an approach to convert real life images into cartoon images using image processing. The cartoon images have sharp edges, reduced colour quantity compared to the original image, and smooth colour regions. With the rapid advancement in artificial intelligence, recently deep learning methods have been developed for image to cartoon generation. Most of these methods perform extremely huge computations and require large datasets and are time consuming, unlike traditional image processing which involves direct manipulation on the input images. In this paper, we have developed an image processing based method for image to cartoon generation. Here, we perform parallel operations of enhancing the edges and quantizing the colour. The edges are extracted and dilated to highlight them in the output colour image. For colour quantization, the colours are assigned based on proposed formulation on separate colour channels. Later, these images are combined and the highlighted edges are added to generate the cartoon image. The generated images are compared with existing image processing approaches and deep learning based methods. From the experimental results, it is evident that the proposed approach generates high quality cartoon images which are visually appealing, have superior contrast and are able to preserve the contextual information at lower comnutational cost.

articleTitle: Repurposing of Anti-Viral Compounds Against HDAC6 in Alzheimer's Therapeutics
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a neurodegenerative disorder with a widespread impact, affecting millions of individuals globally, for which there is currently no cure and available treatments offer only symptomatic relief. HDAC6 has emerged as a promising therapeutic target for AD as it governs the elimination of misfolded proteins and organelles through autophagy, which is defective in AD. Recent studies have demonstrated that certain anti-viral compounds can block HDAC6 activity and promote autophagy in cancer models, leading to the repurposing these drugs for AD treatment. In this literature, we evaluate the potential of anti-viral drugs as HDAC6 inhibitors in AD therapy. We summarize the preclinical data regarding the effectiveness of these drugs in AD models and discuss the opportunities and challenges associated with their advancement in clinical trials. We also underscore the need for further research to optimize the safety and efficacy of these drugs for AD therapy.

articleTitle: Design of CueAid: An Indian Sign Language Recognition Application for Differently Abled
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: The Indian Sign Language (ISL) is a widely used mode of communication among individuals with hearing and speech impairments in India. Unlike spoken language, sign language relies on visual cues such as hand gestures, arm posture, hand orientation, and facial expressions to convey a speaker's message. The majority of communication exchanges in today's society take place via video calls, which have been increasingly in demand. However, differently abled people find it challenging to communicate during video calls as it restricts their ability to express themselves. As a result, it is essential to convert sign language into a form that everyone can understand. The proposed application would help bridge the communication gap between the hearing and speech impaired community and the rest of society. In this study, we propose a system for recognizing action-based ISL. The designed application, CueAid, has two main functions: speech to gesture and gesture to text conversion. The system captures motion using OpenCV, identifies key points using MediaPipe, and employs a trained Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) model for dynamic sign recognition. A custom dataset containing 15 everyday ISL words was created and used in the study, yielding an average accuracy of 93.334%. The created model has the potential to be integrated with the application for real-time recognition of ISL.

articleTitle: Robust Model Predictive Control of a Buck Converter with Constraints
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: DC-DC converters are of significant use in our industry for bucking, boosting, or buck-boosting the input supply voltage. Control of these DC-DC converters is essential for regu-lating their output voltage. In control theory, the LQR technique is very famous but it is unable to handle constraints. This paper focuses on the constrained Model predictive control(MPC) of a buck converter that can handle constraints effectively and efficiently. In this technique, Linear Quadratic Regulator(LQR) cost function is converted to the quadratic programming cost function. Then quadratic programming cost function is solved at every instant to predict the future input to the converter. The controller designed using the above technique is fast and robust against load, and line disturbances. MATLAB results are also developed to demonstrate the effectiveness of the controller.

articleTitle: Design and Deployment of Wild Animal Intrusion Detection & Repellent System Employing IOT
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: In India, there is now effort being done to conserve agriculture, lessen conflict between wildlife and humans, and prevent electric fence shocks from killing wild animals. A system of alerts and repellents against animal infiltration is utilized to address this issue. When an animal is detected by the camera in this system, it automatically sends a message of warning to the landowner and to the forest officials, as well as producing an alert and a sound that deters animals. Artificial intelligence as well as Arduino Uno are used in the process of image processing to categorize the animal. To a forest department as well as the landowner, its GSM module will be sending an SMS alarm notice. Present work will be treated as boon for animal care in future.

articleTitle: Integrated System for Vision-Based SLAM Implementation and Object Detection using AKAZE Feature Descriptor
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM), track the pose of the sensor while simultaneously creating a map of the environment using the Computer Vision approach. There are number of systems that aim towards either generating 3D maps with SLAM or purely performing object detection. The proposed system is a unique combination of SLAM and real-time object detection. The system uses the AKAZE feature descriptor for key-point extraction. The AKAZE feature descriptor outperformed many state-of-the-art feature descriptors such as ORB, SURF, BRISK and SIFT to give more robust and efficient outcomes that are more viable for real-time application. 2-D visualization of extracted key-points and 3-D visualization of the map was generated by using the PyGame library and the Pangolin <tex>$\mathrm{c}++$</tex> library respectively. Object detection was performed using the YOLOv3 model. This model outperformed many state-of-the-art models such as Fast-RCNN, Faster-RCNN, YOLOvl and YOLOv2. A total of 10 experiments were performed in both indoor and outdoor environments for validation of the proposed system. The system was able to successfully evaluate a fragmentary 3D reconstruction of the scene and detect objects in a real-time environment.

articleTitle: In-silico analysis of phytochemical profile of Capparis decidua evince substitutive approach against inhibition of acetylcholinesterase in Alzheimer's
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a persistent neurological condition that is identified by cognitive impairment and the deterioration of memory abilities. AD is supposedly linked to features indicative of the formation of lesions such as neuritic plaques, neurofibrillary tangles, cerebral amyloid angiopathy, neuronal loss, and cholinergic deficiency. Hence, making the associated proteins like amyloid precursor protein cleaving enzyme, butyrylcholinesterase (BuChE), and acetylcholinesterase (AChE) potent targets for curative intervention. As of yet, there is no medication that effectively treats AD. Therefore, the exploitation of bioactive compounds from natural sources can serve as a potential strategy to ameliorate the current treatment. Capparis decidua is a medicinal plant belonging to the family Capparacea has abundance of secondary metabolites like polyphenols, alkaloids, phytosterols, and terpenoids that have been associated with anti-diabetic, antioxidant, anthelmintic, and anti-inflammatory activities. The main goal of this study was to examine the potential of bioactive compounds present in Capparis decidua as an alternative medication for Alzheimer's disease (AD). To achieve this, we conducted an initial in-silico assessment of the therapeutic value of Capparis decidua in the treatment of AD. To achieve this, we analyzed the binding affinities of 55 phytochemicals towards the AChE target, using AutodockVina for molecular docking. Results revealed that Linolenic Acid and 2-hydroxy cinnamic Acid had the lowest binding energy scores of -7.8 (Kcal/mol) and -7.1 (Kcal/mol), respectively and hence the highest binding affinities, which were comparable to the binding energy of the standard control Donepezil (-7.0 Kcal/mol). In addition, we conducted various analyses to assess drug-likeness, bioactivity, permeation through the Blood-Brain Barrier (BBB), and bioavailability of selected phytochemicals, which may have potential as medicative agents against neurodegenerative diseases like AD.

articleTitle: Molecular docking studies of flavonoid's pattern of inhibition against Wnt/β-catenin signaling
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: The Wnt signaling system is an intricate network of cellular communication pathway that is crucial for tissue homeostasis, development, and disease. It is named after a family of secreted proteins called Wnts, which binds to the receptor on the cellular surface to activate intracellular signaling cascades. This system has vital role in growth related conditions and tumours, particularly as a main factor in proliferation and spread of colorectal cancer (CRC), which is correlated with the build-up of β-catenin in the cells due to glycogen synthase kinase-3β (GSK-3β) inactivation. Recently, several polyphenolic substances from the naturally occurring flavonoid family were examined for their potential to inhibit Wnt signaling and found that they exhibit potent anti-oxidant and anti-carcinogenic activities. The article identifies the mechanism by which the flavonoids attach to β-catenin, determining more effective natural inhibitor of the disease-causing protein. In order to clarify the binding efficiency of flavonoids, a comparative molecular docking analysis was carried out in this study.

articleTitle: Data Augmentation Based Brain Tumor Detection Using CNN and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Brain tumor, always being under spotlight threatening human's life expectancy. The high chances of saving people from this life-threatening disease opens the gateway to our research of brain tumor detection. Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is being more efficiently utilized to easily identify the brain tumor. As this medical diagnosis branch of brain tumor detection has a very limited exposure to having datasets with larger sizes, the abundancy to implement Data Augmentation is also equally high. Data Augmentation stands to enrich the existing dataset and the common ways of augmentation are implemented. The implementation of Machine Learning/Deep Learning algorithms in the health industry has also increased exponentially greater over the years. Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have been resonating in the application area with their DL approach. The research work supports the implementation of models such as VGG-16, ResNet-50, DenseNet121. Based on the results we obtain an efficient model is proposed for the detection of brain tumor.

articleTitle: Scalable and Security Framework to Secure and Maintain Healthcare Data using Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: The technological advent of Blockchain, Bigdata, Cloud, and AI made it easier to be stored and retrieved Electronic Health Record (EHR) data and then used it by patients, doctors, and research groups for treatments and analytics. Blockchain security ensures the security of patients' records data with smart contracts due to the most reliable and secure platform for many industries such as finance, IoT, healthcare, and logistics management. The innovative use of smart contracts in the healthcare industry enables a secure system to provide privacy and complete protection with patients' record data and to be able to integrate with various entities in the healthcare sector. The criticality of acquiring, storing, and securing EHR is essential in the healthcare industry to provide faster services. Integrating EHR data with multiple healthcare providers accrues various benefits such as quick insurance approvals and dealing with emergencies and critical situations. It expedites medical records access to patients, doctors, insurance companies, primary healthcare providers, pharmaceuticals, and laboratories to reap healthcare benefits efficiently. The challenges with EHR data are security and storage, which can be addressed with Blockchain security, and integrating it with Bigdata provides huge benefits of data storage, scalability, and performance to store and maintain data efficiently. Often acquiring, storing, securing, and maintaining healthcare data involves excessive administrative and operative costs. Most of the research work is done on Blockchain technology frameworks and implementation but the most critical part of data storage and maintenance is yet to be focused area, as how to manage this data in the long term. This paper intends to research the best Blockchain based architectural framework to store EHR data in Bigdata storage systems at a lesser cost compared to other Infrastructure facilities by utilizing inexpensive hardware grouped into clusters and assigned resources to share across the network and easy to maintain even after procuring the data across the entities securely.

articleTitle: An Intelligent System for Cultivation and Classification of Mushrooms Using Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Mushroom is a sort of fungus looks like a fruit or plant. Unlike plants, they do not require sunlight for energy generation for themselves. Mushrooms are consumed by humans in many European countries and in China. Consumption of mushrooms have enormous benefits in the human body. However, not all mushrooms are edible. While some have the ability to cure cancer, others may be poisonous. It is not possible for a naïve user to identify which all mushrooms are edible and which all are not. So, we propose an Android app- based solution for this problem. The app will scan the image of the mushroom and determine whether it is edible or not using the Machine Vision concept. Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) classification algorithms are used for training and classification purpose. We also develop an automated mushroom house for making the mushroom cultivation easier and more efficient. The temperature, humidity and light parameters are sensed by the sensor and the inbuilt fan and bulb will automatically control the temperature and light inside the mushroom house. We have validated our model and the results shows that our model is much efficient and user friendly than the other existing systems.

articleTitle: A Study of 5G and Edge Computing Integration with IoT- A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: 5G and Edge Computing might sound to very different technology but they aim solve the same problem. In the sense the end goal of both the technology is same that is to provide end user with reducing latency and quick response from their respective devices. 5G on one hand promises to deliver improved speed by increasing it to 10 times of the existing technology (4g). Whereas edge computing aims to reduce the latency by providing computation capabilities to end devices itself while also reducing the bandwidth in the process. Instead of making it obsolete it will improve upon In this research paper features of both 5G and edge computing is discussed. Talking advantage of both technologies' simultaneously integrating with one another will boost their effect and make up for their shortcomings.

articleTitle: Stock Price Prediction Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Nowadays, Machine Learning (ML) has become a trending technology in almost all fields of research. In this paper, an effort has been trying to coin up Machine Learning to predict the stock prices. The objective of this paper is to predict the accurate stock prices which helps the investors to make more accurate and informed investment decision. Therefore, a stock price prediction approach has been proposed to achieve better stock prediction accuracy and caters profitable trades which is based on various mathematical functions and other external factors. Therefore, in this paper, a Machine Learning based Long-Short Term Memory (LSTM) technique has been used to predict the stock prices for short and large capitalization.

articleTitle: Machine Learning and Deep Learning technique used in Customer Churn Prediction: - A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Churn Prediction is crucial in a number of service- based businesses, including the telecom sector, life insurance, hospitality, banking, and gaming. A Prediction of consumer churn in the enterprises is crucial because it is one of the major risks to revenue loss and one of the top concerns for big enterprises. As per studies it is found that the expense of acquiring a new consumer is 10 times greater than the expense of an existing consumer. This issue has an impact on both the company's revenue and its ability to grow. One of the most important tasks for the business is to keep its current customers. As technology advances quickly, Deep Learning and Machine Learning techniques are evolved that businesses can employ to track customer churn behaviour. In this review we will cover, overview on Customer churn, Machine learning Classification and boosting Models as naive bayes, support vector machines, k-nearest neighbor, logistic regression, decision trees, Random Forest, Adaboost, XGBoost and artificial neural networks algorithms, as well as deep learning techniques. We will also explain performance metrics like confusion matrix, Recall, precision, F-measure which is utilized in the churn prediction models. As accuracy is a decent performance indicator, but assessing performance solely by accuracy is insufficient because accuracy on small datasets is more consistent and predictable. In addition to accuracy, researchers must also consider other performance.

articleTitle: Extreme Learning Machine: A Comprehensive Survey of Theories & Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: The Extreme Learning Machine (ELM), a quick and effective approach for training single-hidden-layer feedforward neural networks, is thoroughly reviewed in this paper. The objective is to provide a systematic review and analysis of the various theories, algorithms, and applications of ELM, which have not been adequately covered in the literature. The study examines the theoretical foundations of ELM, provides an overview of various ELM algorithms, analyzes the applications of ELM in different domains, and identifies future research directions and challenges in the field of ELM. The findings suggest that ELM is a promising and effective learning algorithm with many benefits as improved learning speed, good generalisation performance, and low complexity. The implications of this research for practice and research are significant. However, more empirical studies are necessary to evaluate its performance in real-world applications, and further research is required to assess its effectiveness in different domains. Future work should focus on exploring the potential of ELM in deep learning, enhancing the interpretability of ELM models, and developing new algorithms that can improve the learning efficiency of ELM. Overall, this survey provides a valuable reference for researchers and practitioners to better understand the potential and limitations of the ELM algorithm.

Index Terms: Activation Function Of The Hidden Layer

articleTitle: Cyber Security Architecture for Safe Data Storage and Retrieval for Smart City Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: The term “Smart City” refers to incentives for the development that combines “Purely digital Connected City” and municipal government with the aid of ICT. By highlighting the intricacies of the future internet, this innovative idea provides in-depth information and serves as a link between the state, corporations, and the general population. Whenever it pertains to cyber security, issues like data confidentiality and SC potential vulnerabilities are discussed. In this research article, we examine the privacy issues surrounding the growth of the SC assets while also considering the opinions including both the commercial and technological activities into consideration. Additionally, we presented a Smart City Cyber Attack Framework (SCAR) technique. This approach not only creates encrypted information but also assesses the hazards. To establish an urban development, it is ensured that we take into account crucial elements like significant information gathering, storage capacity, restoration, experienced and highly network source high spending power SCAR. The SCAR structure that is proposed advises and maintains a multilayered representation of information storage, clarifies the numerous stakeholders in the communication process, and also guarantees service quality to target consumers. Our recommended approach also looks into cyber security measures put in place for smart urban. Additionally, we explore several facets of the dangers involved with cyberspace while highlighting the unique characteristics of SC-generated difficulties. Finally, the assessment of some important security measures for smart urban put forth by SCAR brings our investigation to a close.

articleTitle: Machine and Deep Learning Approaches For Brain Tumor Identification: Technologies, Applications, and Future Directions
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Brain tumor classification and detection utilizing machine learning and deep learning are increasingly becoming the focus of medical image analysis research. Thanks to the advancement of modern imaging technology and machine learning algorithms, it is now possible to accurately and efficiently classify and diagnose brain tumors using a range of methodologies. Machine learning and deep learning algorithms are currently utilized to assess medical images and categorize tumors based on traits such as shape, size, and texture. Convolutional neural networks (CNNs), a popular deep learning technique, are utilized to identify brain tumors in medical pictures precisely. These models were created using large datasets of brain MRI scans and are incredibly accurate in spotting the presence of cancer. These models have been tested and trained using a variety of freely available datasets, such as the Brain Tumour Segmentation (BraTS) dataset and the LGG/GBM dataset. Researchers have developed several methods for preprocessing the data, increasing the dataset, and fine-tuning the models to improve the models' accuracy further. Overall, categorizing and identifying brain tumors using machine learning and deep learning is a rapidly growing field promising to enhance patient outcomes. By accurately and successfully identifying brain tumors, these techniques can lead to earlier detection and more tailored treatments, ultimately improving patient outcomes. The categorization and detection of brain tumors have been enhanced thanks to machine learning and deep learning on various datasets.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Approach on Multiclass Classification of Internet Firewall Log Files
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Firewalls are critical components in securing communication networks by screening all incoming (and occasionally exiting) data packets. Filtering is carried out by comparing incoming data packets to a set of rules designed to prevent malicious code from entering the network. To regulate the flow of data packets entering and leaving a network, an Internet firewall keeps a track of all activity. While the primary function of log files is to aid in troubleshooting and diagnostics, the information they contain is also very relevant to system audits and forensics. Firewall”s primary function is to prevent malicious data packets from being sent. In order to better defend against cyberattacks and understand when and how malicious actions are influencing the internet, it is necessary to examine log files. As a result, the firewall decides whether to ‘allow.,’ ‘deny.,’ ‘drop,’ or ‘reset-both’ the incoming and outgoing packets. In this research, we apply various categorization algorithms to make sense of data logged by a firewall device. Harmonic mean F1 score, recall, and sensitivity measurement data with a 99% accuracy score in the random forest technique are used to compare the classifier's performance. To be sure, the proposed characteristics did significantly contribute to enhancing the firewall classification rate, as seen by the high accuracy rates generated by the other methods.

articleTitle: A Review on Double Spending Problem in Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: The double-spending problem in blockchain technology is a significant challenge that threatens the integrity and trustworthiness of decentralized systems. This problem occurs when a user attempts to spend the same cryptocurrency unit twice, leading to a situation where the blockchain network must decide which transaction to accept and which to reject. One of the most urgent problems with blockchain technology is the issue of double spending, as it undermines the fundamental principles of trust and transparency that underlie decentralized systems. Various factors can contribute to the double-spending problem, including network latency, malicious actors, and the consensus mechanism used to validate transactions. This study investigates the many approaches put out to solve the double-spending issue in blockchain technology. The proof-of-work consensus mechanism, which necessitates network users to carry out difficult calculations in order to validate transactions, is one of the most popular alternatives. The proof-of-stake consensus technique is an additional remedy, which relies on participants staking their cryptocurrency units to validate transactions. While both mechanisms have their advantages and disadvantages, they are not foolproof and can be vulnerable to attacks. Emerging technologies, like multi-party computation and zero-knowledge proofs, are being investigated in addition to current solutions to the double-spending issue. Overall, this paper highlights the critical nature of the double-spending problem in blockchain technology and evaluates the existing and emerging solutions to the issue.

articleTitle: Stock Market Price Prediction using Machine Learning Techniques: A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: An ordinary person is showing interest in stock trading as it is a great way to make money if done correctly. Although it's a tough task as stock price forecasting requires a lot of knowledge about market share values and trends. Stock market is irregular and dynamic in nature. It is highly uncertain and difficult to detect the behaviour of stock prices. Earlier stock prediction took place with the help of technical, fundamental and econometric models. The sheer volume and complexity of data gathered in today's market makes it impossible for traditional methods of analysis to be effective. Machine learning is increasingly becoming a useful tool for stock estimation. By using sophisticated algorithms to analyse large data sets, machine learning can help identify pattern and trends that may signal future changes in stock prices. Machine learning can also be used to find correlation between stock prices and external environment. This can also be used to make decision about when it might be a favourable time to buy, sell or hold the stock. Stock price estimation can be accurately made using a machine learning algorithm. It is also used to detect anomalies in the market such as insider trading and market manipulation. Stock market price prediction has become a burning research problem among the traders, investors and stock brokers. In this prediction activity investors need fast and real time information for making quick and accurate decisions. In recent past, majority of researchers have designed algorithms for prediction of average movement of stocks and its price. This research paper provide an insight to various modern prediction techniques specially machine learning and sentiment analysis highlighting data set, prediction types, metrics used which are helpful in predicting the stock prices. There is also discussion on outcome, result, research gap and future scope of all these used techniques.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence-Enabled regression model for used car price prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Deciding if the recorded cost of a pre-owned vehicle is a difficult errand, because of the numerous variables that drive a pre-owned car's cost.
