The system also provides an assistive device that helps the physically disabled person to move around with ease. The assistive device is equipped with various sensors and actuators that enable the user to control it using their voice or gestures. The proposed system can significantly improve the quality of life for physically disabled persons by providing them with real-time health monitoring and an assistive device to move around.

articleTitle: Customized Transformer for Confident Browse Node Classification on Imbalanced Product Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Rapid digitization of the world has revitalized the potential of AI. As a result, this phenomenon awakened a huge demand for data-mining pipelines that can efficiently process massive volumes of data to generate valuable insights. For instance, the e-commerce industry is a hub for such high-capacity analytical pipelines as the big players in this industry deal with data pertaining to millions of products, transactions, and users. Consequently, the sheer amount of data used in such AI workflows gives rise to Scalability issues and resource-efficiency issues. As a result, there is a necessity for more computationally efficient approaches that optimize resource allocation and minimize infrastructure costs. Thus, this paper focuses on implementing an efficient product classification pipeline using a customized version of a state-of-the-art transformer-based model which is able to efficiently process data volumes that are comparable to the current voluminosity of industrial data. This customized workflow adapts a loss function that was originally developed for object detection and this adaptation has proved to help the model converge faster and combat class imbalance which is a serious issue in developing large-scale Natural Language Processing systems.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Plant Disease Management Through Image Processing Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Agricultural productivity plays a vital role in the economy, and disease detection in plants is crucial for the agriculture sector as plant diseases are widespread. Failure to take appropriate care can lead to serious consequences for plant quality, quantity, or productivity. For instance, a disease called little leaf disease has been found in pine trees in the United States, which can severely affect plant health. Automated methods for detecting plant diseases are useful as they reduce the need for manual inspection in large crop fields, and they can identify disease symptoms as soon as they appear on plant leaves. This paper presents an algorithm for image segmentation for the automatic identification and classification of plant leaf diseases. It also discusses various disease classification methods that can be used for plant leaf disease detection. Genetic algorithms are used for image segmentation, which is a crucial aspect of disease detection in plant leaves. The paper focuses on identifying the Powdery Mildew disease in organic grape products, which can cause significant damage if not detected in time. The accurate identification and classification of diseases from leaf images are crucial for preventing significant losses in output and agricultural inputs. The proposed process can help improve the accuracy and efficiency of disease detection in plants and lead to better agricultural productivity.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Enabled Classification of Cognitive Impairment Stages Using MRI Images
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Machine learning-based computational health care systems using medical images have undergone rapid advancement in clinical disease diagnosis support. It is very crucial to identify the most common form of dementia, which is Alzheimer's Disease (AD), that progress from a pre-clinical stage called Mild Cognitive Impairment (MCI). This work focuses on the classifications of different progression stages of cognitive impairment to Alzheimer's Disease (AD), using 2D T1 weighted axial MRI images. The images obtained from the ADNI database correspond to various stages of cognitive impairment like Cognitive Normal (CN), Mild Cognitive Impairment (MCI), Early Mild Cognitive Impairment (EMCI), Late Mild Cognitive Impairment (LMCI), and Alzheimer's Disease (AD) with 3000 samples of each class. As the focus of the work is to identify the different development stages of cognitive impairment which progress to AD, it proposes a CNN-based two-class classification network for AD/MCI, AD/CN, and MCI/CN and a five-stage CNN classifier for classifying AD vs CN vs EMCI vs LMCI vs MCI stages, the result thus obtained is compared with transfer learning-based model, the Xception architecture, by performing the binary and five class classification tasks with the same dataset. The proposed CNN-based model gives an accuracy of 93.28% for AD/MCI, 91.92% for AD/CN, and 91.90% for MCI/CN, the overall accuracy of the five class classification using the CNN-based model is 93%. The Transfer learning-based work produced an accuracy of 91.33% for AD/MCI, 88.83% for AD/CN, and 86.9% for MCI/CN, 93.89% for five class classifications. The work also evaluates the class-wise performance of the five class classification tasks with both models to analyze the effectiveness of each class in the classification of cognitive impairment progression stages. The results show that both models classify all five progression stages with good accuracy and high specificity, which assures lesser false positive classification.

articleTitle: Real Estate Property Price Estimator Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Property price estimator is a mobile application by creating a model using machine learning to forecast the sale price of homes in a Bangalore. This model will be built using data on a variety of house features, such as location, size, age, and condition, as well as the sale prices of the houses. In order to commence, we have gathered and prepared the required data so that it is available for analysis. Managing missing or inaccurate numbers and making sure the data is consistent and appropriately reflects the properties and their sale prices may be involved in this. Next, we will perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) to better understand the relationships between the various house features and the sale prices. This involves visualizing the data and identifying patterns and trends that may be useful for building the prediction model. After having a good understanding of the data, next comes building and training the prediction model. This involves selecting and optimizing an appropriate machine learning algorithm, such as linear regression or a decision tree, as well as selecting and engineering relevant features for the model. The model will then be put through its paces using suitable metrics such as R squared and any necessary corrections will be made to increase its accuracy. Users can inquiry price by giving a series of features which describes their ideal house and can get the recommended price. This will be a responsive inquiry system that can greatly improve user's experience.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Review and Evaluation of Machine Learning Approaches for Solar PV Output Power Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Accurate forecasting of solar photovoltaic (PV) output power is a fundamental prerequisite to maintain the optimal management and stability of the grid. This paper presents a review and analysis of the solar photovoltaic power forecasting model based on machine learning techniques. Machine learning techniques are a subfield of artificial intelligence that is widely applied to solve different nonlinear and complex data type systems. The focus of this work is on machine learning methods, which give a thorough and critical analysis of the methodology used to predict PV power output. Furthermore, this study proposed an Ensemble (ENBG) Trees-based machine learning model to incorporate the effect of weather parameters on PV power forecasting. The performance of the proposed machine learning-based model is evaluated and compared with the help of Statistical indices such as Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Mean Square Error (MSE), and R<sup>2</sup> Error and found within desired limits. The proposed forecasting model is found to be more accurate, and it may be useful for smart grid applications to maintain grid stability, reliability, and power quality.

articleTitle: Nature-Inspired Load Balancing Algorithms for Resource Allocation in Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Cloud computing has revolutionized the way computing resources are provisioned and utilized. One of the key challenges in cloud computing is to allocate resources efficiently and effectively, which is known as load balancing. Nature-inspired algorithms have shown great potential in solving complex optimization problems, including load balancing. This research paper aims to study and compare the efficiency of various nature-inspired load balancing algorithms, such as Ant Colony Optimization, Particle Swarm Optimization, Genetic Algorithm, and Artificial Bee Colony. The paper analyzes these algorithms' features, benefits, limitations, and challenges and evaluates their effectiveness in load balancing in distributed systems. The research concludes that nature-inspired load balancing algorithms show promising results and can significantly improve the performance of distributed Cloud systems.

articleTitle: Emotion Classification of Social Media Posts using Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Machines can nowadays understand almost any type of data and they can identify most of the patterns, but identification of emotions or emotion mining has always been a challenging task. Emotion analysis is one of the major research points which aims to classify the text according to the emotions detected. In this paper, we will be analyzing the categories of the emotions in the written text, audio, and videos/images, and the intensity of the emotions. By analyzing the emotions, we can understand the author's perspective on the text. Emotion mining has become a very important part of the online industry because it is one of the major points of customer satisfaction, helps in selecting online material to teach, recommends products based on user emotions, or can be used to detect if the user is undergoing through any mental stress or disorder. During this project, we will be studying and analyzing different approaches which were previously and currently being utilized for the detection of human emotions through data which is in text format. Also, different approaches along with different applications of emotion analysis are vast, we can use it in online shopping apps, to check for customer satisfaction, and it can be used in the field of medicine by doctors to understand the mental status and stress levels of the patient. Emotion analysis can also be used on social media platforms and marriage portals to check for genuineness and the intentions of a person.

articleTitle: Optically Detected Finger Recognition-Based Virtual Keyboard
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: AI Virtual Keyboard is a model that imitates the standard keyboard. This project of virtualizing the hardware keyboard with the help of Computer Vision and the Hand Detecting module allows users to type with hand gestures and modify different layouts of the keyboard. AI virtual keyboard is a computer-based keyboard that works by typing on the optically detectable area which can be used to remove the use of a physical keyboard because a physical keyboard requires many resources and it's restricted by its physical features.

articleTitle: A Compreshensive review on Digital Image Watermarking Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: With the increasing prevalence of digital media, it is crucial to develop effective methods for transferring hidden data, establishing ownership of digital content, and safeguarding the rights of creators. In this article, we present a comprehensive analysis of watermarking strategies specifically employed in machine learning systems. Our investigation begins with an overview of the foundational principles of digital watermarking, encompassing both traditional practices and advancements facilitated by machine learning. Subsequently, we delve into a discussion of the most widely utilized digital watermarking techniques based on deep learning models. We conduct a comparative analysis of these techniques, examining their strengths and weaknesses. Furthermore, we provide a summary and analysis of the latest contributions to the field, thereby capturing the current state of research. By exploring the realm of watermarking strategies within machine learning, our study aims to shed light on advancements in this field and offer valuable insights into the most effective approaches. Protecting digital content and ensuring the integrity of shared information are critical objectives. Understanding the strengths and limitations of different watermarking techniques can pave the way for the development of more resilient and efficient solutions.

articleTitle: Assessing the Landscape of Mobile Data Vulnerabilities: A Comprehensive Review
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: The widespread adoption of mobile devices in recent years has made them an integral part of our daily lives. However, with the increased usage of mobile devices for sensitive data transactions, the threat of mobile data vulnerabilities has also grown significantly. This paper presents a comprehensive review of the landscape of mobile data vulnerabilities to help researchers and practitioners understand the current state of mobile security and identify potential areas for improvement. The paper starts by defining the term “mobile data vulnerability” and explaining the various types of vulnerabilities that can affect mobile devices, including network-based, software-based, and physical vulnerabilities. It then reviews the current literature on mobile data vulnerabilities and provides an in-depth analysis of the latest research findings, trends, and emerging threats. The paper also examines the various mitigation techniques that have been proposed to address mobile data vulnerabilities, such as secure coding practices, intrusion detection systems, and device hardening measures. Additionally, the paper highlights the challenges and limitations of these techniques, and discusses the need for a more comprehensive and integrated approach to mobile security. Finally, the paper concludes with recommendations for future research directions in mobile data vulnerabilities. It suggests that future research should focus on developing more effective and efficient methods for detecting and mitigating mobile data vulnerabilities, as well as on improving user education and awareness to help prevent mobile security incidents. Overall, this paper provides a valuable resource for researchers and practitioners interested in mobile security by presenting a comprehensive review of the landscape of mobile data vulnerabilities and identifying potential areas for future research and improvement.

articleTitle: Classification and Detection of Malware in Android: An Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: In the 21<sup>st</sup> century, the usage of the android operating system has increased at a very high rate thus thereby an increase in the number of subsequent apps that span and are used in android. As the number of android devices are increasing, the number of malicious actors producing android malware applications, which easily get downloaded on devices, is also increasing which makes the fight between security analysts and malware developers never-ending. Due to an increase in the number of apps, it is necessary to classify the apps either as benign or malware affected. The variation of android malware applications is being tackled by using machine learning and deep learning. This paper presents the detection and prediction of malware applications based on their app permission using machine learning algorithms. Further, their performance in classifying the apps is analyzed in terms of accuracy, recall score, and ROC scores. Results indicate that XG Boost and multilayer perceptron have higher accuracy of 98%. However random forest has a higher recall score of 99%.

articleTitle: Drowsiness Alert System: An Approach To Save The Life
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Face is the key of many types of information. In the daily life of any drivers, they face a lot of problems. we see how they do overtime and night shifts which means they have to do continuous driving day and night for long which results in tiredness and fatigue problems. These problems seem to be very minor but can cause major and fatal accidents. Every year we see a rise in number of accidents due to drowsiness and fatigue in which many people losses their lives and there is also the loss of infrastructure and capitals. We mostly see that drivers get tired due to continuous driving and so feel sleepy or even sometime fall asleep due to which they lost control over the vehicle and serious problems can take place. In this paper, we are designing a module which will detect the drowsiness of driver by detecting the drivers' eyes which will give the information about the driver, if the eyes were closed then it will detect the drowsiness. After detecting it will give the warning to the driver. In this we use algorithm which to locates the eyes, face, and other facial elements to check the drowsiness of the driver.

articleTitle: Improved Machine leaning algorithms for sentiment analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Numerous research have applied sentiment analysis to Twitter because of the vast amounts of data being created there. These social media platforms produce huge amounts of unstructured data streams that are difficult to deal with. Massive volumes of unstructured data are produced by such social network services, making their management extremely difficult. articleTitle: Classification of Online Sentiment Data tweets using Various Approaches in Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Online data is the data that is present on an online platform such as social media. Social media contains various information through which it can analyze users' attitudes & behavior. Sentimental analysis enables the automatic analysis of expression whether it is positive or negative. It can be about places, people, events, organizations, brands, products, etc. By using tools provided by machine learning & natural language processing with different approaches sentiment analysis can be made possible. The ubiquitous use of the Online World has given people a new method for expressing their emotions. It also functions as a platform with a shedload of knowledge where viewers may examine other users' thoughts, which are categorized into so many sentiment classifications and have become more and more essential in judgment. The representation of the number of comments that contain complex multidimensional sentiments that are either good or bad or anything in between the two can really be analyzed by means of this paper's approach to sentiment classification for consumer review classification. In this research, sentiment contribution in the field of online data tweets are collected, and using various machine learning algorithms results are identified as collective actions using different accuracy.

articleTitle: Pixellayer- A novel approach for stitching digital Images and Videos
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: Image stitching and video stitching are the techniques to solve the problem of overlapping fields of view in images and videos using AI technologies. The creations of panoramic images using computer vision are primarily focused on creating panoramas using a library of images. The basic idea of this research is to propose a suitable method to meet the needs of stitching two or more images and further generate a 360° visualization of that stitched image. This method performs stitching of real-time images using live wireless cameras. Proposed approach ‘Pixellayer’ also removes the usage of a wide-angle wireless camera for stitching which makes this approach efficient in terms of cost. It includes the feature of frames per second and captures the live movement of an object in a real-time environment. It also solves the problem of blind spots of security wireless cameras and creating cinematic effects.

articleTitle: Evaluating Performance Of Convolution Neural Networks And Their Ensembles For Face Mask Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Sustainable Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract: During the Pandemic CoVID-19 there was a need to monitor the public spaces for correct usage of Face Mask to control the spread of infection. There has been extremely good improvement in the field of Image Processing using the Machine Learning Methods like Neural Networks. But there is lack of datasets with High Quality images and separate set for incorrect usage of masks. So we used the Mask Superimposition technique to create a dataset of HQ face mask images. We also compared different Machine Learning Models on different metrics like accuracy, loss, F1-Score and Kappa Score. We also develop multiple ensemble models and compare their performance.
